translation_method: Independently authored and sentence reviewed against the pinned source and current game terminology.

units.source: There are several factions in the game and 3 measures ({#1}Renown{/#1}, {#2}Reputation{/#2} & {#3}Relations{/#3}) that denote your standing and fame with Settlements and Noble Houses, which are the only factions you can have friendly interactions with (receive {#4}Contracts{/#4}, trade, heal, use ports for travel, etc).
units.zh: 游戏中有多个势力，并用 3 项指标表示战团的地位与名气：{#1}声望{/#1}、{#2}声誉{/#2}和{#3}关系{/#3}。这些指标影响聚落及贵族家族对你的看法；只有这些势力能与你进行友好互动，例如提供{#4}委托{/#4}、交易、治疗或港口旅行。

units.source: Your {#1}Renown{/#1} is your repute as a professional mercenary company and reflects how reliable and competent people judge you to be. The higher your {#2}Renown{/#2}, the higher the reward from {#3}Contracts{/#3} and the more difficult {#4}Contracts{/#4} people will entrust you with, and the more resources your enemies will spend on working against you. {#5}Renown{/#5} increases on successfully completing {#6}Contracts{/#6} and winning battles, and decreases on failing to do so.
units.zh: {#1}声望{/#1}代表战团作为职业佣兵的名气，反映人们对你能力与可靠程度的评价。{#2}声望{/#2}越高，{#3}委托{/#3}报酬越高，人们也越愿意把困难的{#4}委托{/#4}交给你，同时敌人会投入更多资源来对付你。完成{#6}委托{/#6}和赢得战斗会提高{#5}声望{/#5}，失败则会降低声望。

units.source: The company starts between {#1}-100{/#1} and 200 {#2}Renown{/#2} upon starting a new campaign depending on the chosen {#3}Origin{/#3}. You can see your current renown at the top of the {#4}{#5}Factions & Relations{/#5} window.{/#4}
units.zh: 新战役开始时，战团的初始{#2}声望{/#2}介于 {#1}-100{/#1} 至 200 之间，取决于所选{#3}起源{/#3}。当前声望显示在{#4}{#5}势力与关系{/#5}窗口顶部。{/#4}

units.source: Your {#1}Reputation{/#1} reflects how people in the world judge your mercenary company to conduct itself based on past actions. Do you show mercy to your enemies? Do you burn down farmsteads and massacre the peasantry? Based on your {#2}Reputation{/#2}, people may offer you different kinds of contracts, and both contracts and events may play out differently.
units.zh: {#1}声誉{/#1}反映世人如何评价战团过去的行事方式：你会善待敌人，还是焚烧农庄、屠杀平民？不同{#2}声誉{/#2}可能带来不同类型的委托，也可能改变委托与事件的发展。

units.source: If you have a Reputation of 80 or higher, you will not get any {#1}Raze Attached Location{/#1} Contracts offered.
units.zh: 声誉达到 80 或以上时，不会收到{#1}摧毁附属地点{/#1}委托。

units.source: With {#1}Oathtakers{/#1} Origin, you can access {#2}Bad Reputation{/#2} and {#3}Oathtaker Happy with Company{/#3} events depending on your reputation.
units.zh: 选择{#1}立誓者{/#1}起源时，声誉会影响能否触发{#2}恶名{/#2}和{#3}立誓者满意战团{/#3}事件。

units.source: Depending on the chosen {#1}Origin{/#1} you start with a {#2}Reputation{/#2} of 50.
units.zh: 初始{#2}声誉{/#2}通常为 50，具体取决于所选{#1}起源{/#1}。

units.source: Every settlement has their own {#1}Relations{/#1} bar on the same screen that displays {#2}Renown{/#2} and {#3}Reputation{/#3}. All settlements start with the bar at Neutral.
units.zh: 每个聚落都有独立的{#1}关系{/#1}条，与{#2}声望{/#2}和{#3}声誉{/#3}显示在同一界面。所有聚落的初始关系均为“中立”。

units.source: The player can increase and decrease the {#1}Relation{/#1} to each settlement by doing certain Actions. (Table below)
units.zh: 玩家的特定行为会提高或降低与各聚落的{#1}关系{/#1}，详见下表。

units.source: Good {#1}Relations{/#1} improve market prices. (lowers prices for buyable items on markets and increases prices for items that the player wants to sell)
units.zh: 良好的{#1}关系{/#1}能改善市场价格：购买物品更便宜，出售物品的收入更高。

units.source: Relations trend towards 50 and these minute shifts in {#1}Relations{/#1} take place at dawn of each day. (applies to both decay and gain, so a settlement at Hostile(0) will take roughly 40 days to reach Threatening(10))
units.zh: {#1}关系{/#1}会逐渐向 50 回归，每天黎明时发生小幅变化，无论原先高于还是低于这一数值。因此，关系为“敌对”（0）的聚落，大约需要 40 天才能回升至“威胁”（10）。

units.source: Fortified settlements (Fortified Manor/Castle/Stronghold) are fully affiliated with their Noble House and do not have separate {#1}Relations{/#1} bar unlike non-fortified settlements. Their {#2}Relation{/#2} score is essentially the {#3}Relation{/#3} with the Noble House in question which is used to determine prices.
units.zh: 设防聚落，包括设防庄园、城堡和要塞，完全隶属于贵族家族。与普通聚落不同，它们没有独立的{#1}关系{/#1}条，而是直接使用你与所属贵族家族的{#3}关系{/#3}作为本地{#2}关系{/#2}，并据此决定价格。

units.source: Buying a Drink for the Patrons in the Tavern
units.zh: 在酒馆请在场的客人喝一杯

units.source: {#1}Villages and the bigger towns are a collective term for all human civilian settlements that are located across the world map. Villages are mostly inhabited by farmers, hunters, local craftsmen and small time traders. The people of the villages usually live off the surrounding land and by selling their produce and wares on bigger markets in nearby villages or towns.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}村庄及较大的城镇，统称为分布在世界地图上的人类平民聚落。村庄里主要住着农民、猎人、本地工匠和小商贩。村民通常依靠周围土地维生，再将农产品与制成品运到附近村镇的大市场出售。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}In case of an urgent threat normal townsfolk are gathered hastily and equipped with whatever weapons and armor are available. These ad-hoc militia forces are not trained soldiers and lack equipment and combat experience. Nevertheless, they will fight fiercely to protect what little they have and to protect those dear to them. Militia forces can be gathered when a hostile party is sighted close to a settlement and disbanded again after the threat disappeared. Local leaders will attempt to hire mercenaries for protection so the player will often find work around these settlements.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}遇到迫在眉睫的威胁时，普通居民会匆忙集合，拿起能找到的武器与护甲。这些临时民兵并非受过训练的士兵，装备和战斗经验都很有限；但为了守护仅有的家当与亲人，他们仍会奋力作战。敌对队伍接近聚落时，民兵便会集结，威胁解除后再解散。地方领袖也会雇用佣兵保护聚落，因此玩家常能在这里找到工作。{/#1}

units.source: The main role for these settlements (Village Hall/Town Hall/City Hall) is to trade with the player, provide new recruits and offer contracts. As of the full release version 1.1, all human settlements are now aligned with a noble house. Independent, unaligned settlements which were present in Early Access builds, no longer exist. From time to time these settlements spawn caravans who trade goods with the other towns or villages.
units.zh: 拥有村公所、镇公所或市政厅的平民聚落，主要负责与玩家交易、提供新兵和委托。自正式版 1.1 起，所有人类聚落都归属于某个贵族家族，抢先体验时期的独立聚落已不复存在。这些聚落会不时派出商队，与其他村镇交易货物。

units.source: If hostile troops raid a village or town, a group of militia soldiers spawn, ready to defend their homes and families. These militias are often nothing more than poorly armed farmers and may require aid from the player.
units.zh: 敌军袭击村镇时，当地会组建民兵保卫家园与家人。这些民兵往往只是装备简陋的农夫，可能需要玩家援助。

units.source: A rich town can field more militia than a poor town.
units.zh: 富裕城镇能派出的民兵，比贫穷城镇更多。

units.source: Every caravan that safely arrives at a settlement increases it's prosperity rating.
units.zh: 每支平安抵达聚落的商队，都会提高该聚落的繁荣度。

units.source: A prosperous settlement might have a militia captain, an experienced veteran who provides them with a morale bonus.
units.zh: 繁荣的聚落可能拥有一名民兵队长。这位经验丰富的老兵能够为民兵提供士气加成。

units.source: A settlement with a higher prosperity rating will offer more and better equipment.
units.zh: 繁荣度越高的聚落，出售的装备越多，品质也越好。

units.source: {#1}Historically, bigger realms have always been a very diverse mixture of a lot of smaller realms and fiefdoms ruled by competing and collaborating noble houses. Although these small parts were usually devoted to a king or supreme ruler, they often changed allegiance and fought and schemed against each other in their struggle for power. The feuds between these noble houses create a perfect place for a mercenary company that is not bound to a lord and that can take on whatever contract pays best.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}在历史上，大国往往由许多小领地和封邑组成，统治它们的贵族家族既竞争也合作。虽然这些小领地通常效忠同一位国王或最高统治者，却常在权力斗争中改换阵营、相互征战与算计。家族间的宿怨，恰好为不受领主束缚、可以选择高价委托的佣兵团提供了生存空间。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Like most things in Battle Brothers, noble houses are procedurally generated for each new campaign. To give them as much personality as possible we want them to look and feel very distinct from one another. Each noble house comes with a unique coat of arms, description and set of procedurally generated leaders.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}与《战场兄弟》中的许多内容一样，贵族家族会在每次新战役中随机生成。开发者希望各家族在外观和气质上都有鲜明差异，因此为每个家族设置了独特纹章、背景描述，以及一组随机生成的领袖。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Noble houses also come with their very own coat of arms. We dove deep into medieval heraldry to make the coats of arms realistic and believable, but we also took a bit of artistic license to make them easier to read and more catchy.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}贵族家族还拥有各自的纹章。开发者深入研究了中世纪纹章学，力求让设计真实可信，同时也加入适度的艺术处理，使纹章更醒目、更易辨认。{/#1}

units.source: Fortified settlements (Fortified Manors/Castles/Strongholds) belong to different noble houses, and the house which controls one can be identified by the flag they wear. These constructions are guarded by strong garrisons of men at arms who search the area for ambushing brigands, beasts and other threats. The men at arms usually carry the best possible equipment. These settlements will spawn patrols, which secure the streets between the settlements of their house. If a threat, example given: a brigand party, comes close to a castle, a group of soldiers will spawn at the castle to fight the threat. To a castle usually belongs 1 or more watchtower(s). These also spawn soldiers for a patrol or if a threat comes near.
units.zh: 设防庄园、城堡和要塞分别归属于不同贵族家族，可通过旗帜辨认其主人。它们由强大的职业士兵驻守，这些士兵通常装备精良，会在周围搜寻伏击的强盗、野兽及其他威胁。设防聚落会派出巡逻队，保护家族领地内聚落之间的道路；若强盗等敌对队伍逼近城堡，也会出兵迎击。一座城堡通常还附属 1 座或更多瞭望塔，瞭望塔同样会派出巡逻队，或在敌人接近时出兵。

units.source: Strongholds and castles can usually provide more equipment and recruits than smaller settlements.
units.zh: 要塞和城堡通常比小聚落提供更多装备和新兵。

units.source: Strongholds and castles offer better, military grade equipment, but are much more expensive.
units.zh: 要塞和城堡出售更优质的军用装备，但价格也高得多。

units.source: Fortified settlements also do not give out regular contracts like non-fortified settlements. Contracts found here are given out by the Noble House and require completing an ambition to reach Professional Renown (1050) to unlock.
units.zh: 设防聚落不会像普通聚落那样提供常规委托；这里的委托由贵族家族发布。需要完成将声望提高至“专业”（1050）的战团抱负，才能解锁。

units.source: There are two types of caravans: Standard caravans, which are simply named caravans, and supply caravans.
units.zh: 商队分为两类：普通商队，在地图上直接称为商队；以及补给商队。

units.source: Caravans spawn from time to time in human settlements and travel to another settlement to trade.
units.zh: 人类聚落会不时派出商队，前往其他聚落交易。

units.source: Trading caravans can be attacked by the player using {#1}Ctrl+Click{/#1}, if he doesn't have an active contract and when the player has a low relation with the settlement it originates from (usually a relation with the status "threatening" or lower.) The font color of the caravan then also changes into red, instead of white.
units.zh: 没有正在执行的委托，且与商队出发聚落的关系较差时，玩家可用 {#1}Ctrl+单击{/#1}攻击商队，通常需要关系处于“威胁”或更低等级。此时商队名称也会由白色变为红色。

units.source: Further information about prosperity can be found {#1}a few lines up{/#1}.
units.zh: 繁荣度的更多说明见{#1}上文{/#1}。

units.source: Supply caravans are highly guarded caravans and are part of a noble house. Which house can be identified by the flag they wear.
units.zh: 补给商队属于贵族家族，护卫严密，可通过旗帜辨认其所属家族。

units.source: Travels only between settlements controlled from the same noble house.
units.zh: 仅在同一贵族家族控制的聚落之间往来。

units.source: Supply caravans can be attacked by the player using {#1}Ctrl+Click{/#1}, if he doesn't have an active contract and when the player has a low relation with the settlement it originates from (usually a relation with the status "threatening" or lower.) The font color of the caravan then also changes into red, instead of white.
units.zh: 没有正在执行的委托，且与补给商队出发聚落的关系较差时，玩家可用 {#1}Ctrl+单击{/#1}攻击它，通常需要关系处于“威胁”或更低等级。此时商队名称也会由白色变为红色。

units.source: {#1}Similar to player company there are other mercenary units that take contracts for the living in Darklands.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}与玩家战团一样，黑暗之地也有其他佣兵队伍靠承接委托谋生。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}In a medieval world there are always those who have fallen out of society for whatever reason. Some are plain criminals, some are desperate and close to starving others are just looking for freedom far from local authorities. All these characters live in the woods, hills and wilderness around the human settlements and are looking for a way to survive by their own means.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}中世纪世界里，总有人因各种原因被社会抛弃。有的是罪犯，有的绝望而饥肠辘辘，还有的只是想远离地方当局、寻求自由。他们栖身于人类聚落周围的森林、丘陵和荒野，各自寻找生存之道。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}These outcasts usually avoid direct confrontation and prefer to ambush trade caravans and lone travelers along the roads. Most of them have gathered in small groups and built some form of hideout where they take their robbed goods.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}这些流亡者通常避免正面对抗，更喜欢沿路伏击商队和落单旅人。大多数人会结成小团伙，搭建藏身处，将劫来的财物带回其中。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Brigands may not be very well fed and equipped but a life of hardship has made them tough and cunning fighters that will use any dirty trick and advantage they can get to save their hide.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}强盗或许吃不饱、装备也不好，但艰苦生活让他们成为强悍狡猾的战士。为了保命，他们会利用一切卑鄙手段和可乘之机。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Brigand{/#1} parties consist of criminals, starving or down-on-their-luck men, and people looking for a unique kind of freedom in their own way. Brigands live in the woods, hills, and wilderness around the human settlements and are looking for a way to survive by their own means. Brigands usually avoid direct confrontation and prefer to ambush weaker enemies. Their harsh life made them tough fighters. Brigand parties not only attack the player and the player friendly factions (like settlements and patrols), they also attack orcs, goblins and beasts. Brigand parties like to hide alongside roads which pass through forests.
units.zh: {#1}强盗{/#1}队伍由罪犯、饥民、落魄者，以及以自己的方式追求自由的人组成。他们住在人类聚落周围的森林、丘陵和荒野，设法自行谋生。强盗通常避免正面对抗，倾向伏击较弱的敌人；艰苦生活也使他们变得强悍。除了玩家及与玩家友好的聚落、巡逻队，强盗还会攻击兽人、地精和野兽。他们尤其喜欢潜伏在穿越森林的道路旁。

units.source: {#1}The beast faction is not a typical faction as it is not united within itself. This faction consists of all kinds of dangerous and mystical creatures that roam the lands independently and threaten its inhabitants.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}野兽并非通常意义上的统一势力，而是各种独自游荡、威胁居民的危险生物与神秘怪物的统称。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}The first creature that is already in the game is the Direwolves. These huge wolflike creatures always travel in packs and are not hindered by darkness at night. They are extremely fast and although they do not use weapons or armor they are absolutely deadly when using their fangs and claws.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}最早加入游戏的野兽是恐狼。这种巨大的狼形生物总是成群行动，夜幕不会阻碍它们。它们速度极快，虽然不用武器或护甲，尖牙利爪却足以致命。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}The undead are long deceased bodies and remainders of once living creatures brought back to life by dark powers. The creatures of the undead faction are numerous and vary in combat ability, tactics and equipment. The body of their forces is usually compromised of zombies and skeletons but they also field elite troops like heavily armored fallen heroes, incorporeal lost souls and powerful reanimated lords. The undead often appear with a leader that is directing their soulless and mindless bodies in the right direction. This can be a necromancer, still a human being but corrupted by sinister powers, a vampire lusting for the blood of the living, or something even worse.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}亡灵是被黑暗力量重新唤起的尸体与残骸，种类繁多，战斗能力、战术与装备各异。它们的主力通常是行尸和骷髅，也包括重甲陨落英雄、无形的游魂，以及复生领主等精锐。亡灵往往由领袖驱使，令这些无魂无知的躯体朝着正确方向前进。领袖可能是仍属人类、却被邪恶力量腐化的亡灵法师，也可能是渴望活人鲜血的吸血鬼，甚至是更可怕的存在。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}The undead have some special traits that govern how they fight in combat. They have no stamina and do not accumulate any fatigue. With a few exceptions, the undead are also immune to morale effects, such as panic, and will never flee the battlefield. On the upside, most of them are rather slow and not all of them act particularly intelligent in battle.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}亡灵的特殊性质决定了它们的作战方式：它们不会累积疲劳。除少数例外，大多数亡灵也免疫惊慌等士气效果，绝不会逃离战场。好在它们通常行动迟缓，战术也未必聪明。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}When fighting the undead, players have to watch their fatigue closely as the undead do not get tired like your Battle Brothers. Many undead can be resurrected again and again, which can have battles last a long time, straining fatigue until all humans are so tired that the undead finally overcome them despite their supposed individual weakness.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}对抗亡灵时，玩家必须特别注意疲劳，因为敌人不会像佣兵一样疲倦。许多亡灵可以一再复活，令战斗拖得很久。即使单个亡灵看似弱小，也可能熬到人类筋疲力尽，再将其击败。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}As long as humans remember there has been tensions with the wild orc tribes that roam the surrounding lands. Orcs live as nomads, constantly on the move to support themselves by hunting, gathering and raiding anyone weaker than their tribe. Life for an orc, then, is to a large part establishing dominance over others and taking things for him or herself.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}自人类有记忆以来，就始终与周围荒野中的兽人部落关系紧张。兽人过着游牧生活，不断迁移，靠狩猎、采集和劫掠弱者维生。对兽人而言，生活的很大一部分就是压倒他者，将想要的东西据为己有。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}In Battle Brothers, orcs are physically stronger than humans. An adult orc towers a human and has the strength to use weaponry and wear armor with great effect that would quickly tire out any human. With their strength, they also gain a percentage damage bonus to every attack – less for young orcs , and more so for adult ones. While orcs are subject to fatigue and morale, just like your Battle Brothers are, they have plenty of both, and it takes a while for an orc to run out of steam or realize that a battle has turned against him.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}《战场兄弟》中的兽人比人类更强壮。成年兽人体形高大，能够轻松使用足以迅速耗尽人类体力的武器和重甲。强大的力量也使它们的每次攻击获得百分比伤害加成，青年兽人的加成较少，成年兽人更多。兽人同样会累积疲劳，也受士气影响，但两方面都十分充裕，往往要过很久才会体力不支，或意识到战局已经不利。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Orcs focus entirely on the offense, where they excel. They use their skills to crush the player’s battle line with raw force and have it quickly dissolve into a chaotic frenzy where they generally have the upper hand. For this reason, meeting an orc warband head-on in open battle is usually a bad idea and will leave you at a disadvantage. On the other hand, orcs neglect defense; while some of them will carry shields, they seldom make active use of them, preferring instead to attack. Due to their reckless fighting style and just physically being big targets, they’re also easier to hit than other opponents.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}兽人专注于自己擅长的进攻，凭蛮力冲垮玩家战线，将战斗迅速拖入混乱近战，而这正是它们占优的局面。因此，在开阔地正面迎战兽人战帮，通常会让自己处于劣势。另一方面，兽人疏于防守：即使带盾，也很少主动防御，更愿意发动攻击。鲁莽的作风加上庞大体形，使它们比许多其他敌人更容易被命中。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Orcs{/#1} live like nomads and are taller and stronger than humans. Those tribes usually go off and raid settlements. But they also have their own wars, where one clan fights against another. Due to their strength they are able to use {#2}heavy weaponry{/#2} and wear heavy armor which humans can’t use without disadvantages. Because of their strength, orcs gain a damage bonus to every attack. Young orcs gain a lesser bonus than adult orcs. Orcs have a lot of fatigue and morale, it maybe take quite a while for an orc to realize that a battle has turned against him/them. In battle, they focus on the offense. They like to destroy the shield wall or line of the player using their force, a battle is likely to quickly escalate into a chaotic mess.
units.zh: {#1}兽人{/#1}过着游牧生活，比人类更高大强壮。它们常劫掠聚落，部落之间也会相互征战。强大的力量让它们能够使用{#2}重型武器{/#2}和重甲，而人类使用同样装备时会承受明显负担。兽人的每次攻击都有伤害加成，青年少于成年。它们疲劳储备充足、士气顽强，往往很久才会意识到战局不利。作战时，兽人专注进攻，喜欢以蛮力打破玩家的盾墙与阵线，将战场迅速搅成混乱。

units.source: {#1}Goblins are technically just one half of a larger faction, the greenskins, with the other half being the orcs. However, both orcs and goblins are highly autonomous and you’ll only see them work together on rare occasions.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}严格来说，地精只是绿皮势力的一半，另一半是兽人。不过，两者各自独立行动，只在少数情况下并肩作战。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Goblins are a lot smaller than both orcs and humans, and appear to be physically weak at first sight. Due to their lack of strength they have developed a completely different approach to battle from their larger cousins. Instead of brute force they rely on ambushes, hit-and-run attacks, wit and dirty tricks. Goblins employ many means to hinder the enemy’s movement and once the enemy is incapacitated they engage to wear their opponents down.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}地精远比兽人和人类矮小，看起来也更孱弱。正因为缺乏力量，它们发展出与兽人截然不同的战法：依靠伏击、打了就跑、计谋与阴招，而非蛮力。地精会想尽办法阻碍敌人移动，待其行动受限后，再逐步将其消耗殆尽。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}When fighting goblins a solid battle line will just get harassed from afar until it is safe for the goblins to engage the worn out survivors in close combat. The player has to be quick to catch the swift greenskins and then pin them down in melee where they can not use their ranged weapons. Also, goblins are not known to be the most brave fighters around. To keep them fighting there is often a leader around, keeping morale up by all means necessary, such as like swinging a whip at those who fall back. Taking care of him can easily scatter a band of goblins.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}对付地精时，固守战线只会不断遭到远程骚扰，直到幸存者疲惫不堪，地精才会放心上前近战。玩家必须迅速追上这些灵巧的绿皮，将它们拖入近战，使其无法使用远程武器。地精并不以勇敢著称，因此常有一名领袖在旁维持士气，必要时用鞭子抽打后退者。除掉这名领袖，往往就能让整队地精溃散。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Goblins{/#1} are kinda related to orcs. Together with the orcs, they complete a greater faction; the „Greenskins“. But orcs and goblins act highly independent and also don't really like each other, which will sometime result in fights. Goblins are smaller than humans and appear to be weaker. Instead of brute force they usually ambush their enemies. (Hit-and-run attacks). They use poisoned {#2}arrows and weapons{/#2}.
units.zh: {#1}地精{/#1}与兽人有一定亲缘关系，两者合称“绿皮”。不过，它们高度独立，也彼此不合，偶尔还会交战。地精比人类矮小，看起来更弱，因此通常采用伏击、袭扰与撤退战术，而非蛮力硬拼。它们会使用淬毒的{#2}箭矢和武器{/#2}。

units.source: {#1/} The world map is randomly generated at the beginning of each game. Every world is filled with {#2}settlements{/#2} which are aligned to one of the 3 Noble {#3}Factions{/#3}. A typical setup involves a total of 17 settlements (2 City Halls, 3 Town Halls, 6 Village Halls, 2 Strongholds, 2 Castles, 2 Fortified Manors). Settlement distribution amongst Noble Houses can vary considerably, ranging from being roughly equal (6/6/5) to clearly lopsided (10/5/2). Settlements are where the Player Company can resupply (market/armorer/weaponsmith), find new recruits, treat injuries to make them heal faster (temple) and get an xp boost (training grounds).
units.zh: {#1/}世界地图在每次新游戏开始时随机生成。地图上的{#2}聚落{/#2}分别归属于 3 个贵族{#3}势力{/#3}。典型地图共有 17 个聚落，包括 2 座城市、3 座城镇、6 座村庄、2 座要塞、2 座城堡和 2 座设防庄园。各家族控制的聚落数量可能大致均衡，例如 6/6/5，也可能相差悬殊，例如 10/5/2。玩家可在聚落的市场、护甲匠和武器匠处补充物资，招募新人，在神殿加快伤势恢复，或到训练场获得经验加成。

units.source: Enemy camps which are revealed on taking contracts and on map exploration are locations that can be pillaged and destroyed.
units.zh: 接取委托或探索地图时发现的敌方营地，可以被劫掠和摧毁。

units.source: Various terrain provide different environment for tactical fight. With {#1}0.6.0.20 update{/#1} weather was added. Light snow can fall in the tundra and frozen north, and the latter can see even full-grown snow storms. These weather effects are purely cosmetic.
units.zh: 不同地形会形成不同的战术战场。{#1}0.6.0.20 更新{/#1}加入了天气：苔原和冰封北地会飘起小雪，极北地区甚至会出现暴风雪。这些天气效果仅影响画面。

units.source: Battles initiated here will have tiles comprised predominantly of Grassland and Steppe (2AP, 4Fatigue) and less commonly Dry Steppe (2AP, 2Fatigue). If the battle occurs close to a road, Cobblestone Road tiles (2AP, 2Fatigue) are occasionally seen as well.
units.zh: 此处的战场主要由草地与草原地块组成，移动消耗 2 行动点、4 疲劳；较少出现的干草原地块消耗 2 行动点、2 疲劳。若战斗发生在道路附近，也可能出现消耗 2 行动点、2 疲劳的石板路。

units.source: All ambitions give at least 100 {#1}renown{/#1} (which boosts contract payout) and lift the mood of the entire company. Some offer other rewards. An ambition can be cancelled at any time but it comes at the cost of a morale hit for the company. Abandoned ambitions will not be available the next time an ambition is chosen, though subsequently can appear again.
units.zh: 所有战团抱负完成后，至少提供 100 {#1}声望{/#1}，从而提高委托报酬，并改善全团心情；部分还会给予其他奖励。抱负可随时取消，但会打击战团士气。放弃的抱负不会在下一次选择时出现，不过之后仍可能再次出现。

units.source: After the {#1}Make Nobles Aware{/#1} ambition has been completed, an option to select "No Ambition" will begin appearing. Selecting "No Ambition" means waiting 3 days before you get to choose again. Cancelling an ambition only results in waiting a day or two before getting to choose again.
units.zh: 完成{#1}引起贵族注意{/#1}后，抱负选择中会开始出现“暂不设立抱负”。选择它后，需要等待 3 天才能再次选择；若取消已有抱负，则通常只需等待一两天。

units.source: Ambition unavailability is often temporary. For example: if you have 3 helms with 230+ durability when choosing an ambition, the {#1}Armor Mastery{/#1} ambition will never be an option, but if you sell one of the helms, you can once again receive the ambition as a choice. The {#2}Have 50000 Crowns{/#2} ambition can even be completed prior to the {#3}Have 10000 Crowns{/#3} ambition.
units.zh: 抱负不可选，往往只是暂时的。例如，选择抱负时若已拥有 3 顶耐久至少为 230 的头盔，就不会出现{#1}护甲精通{/#1}；卖掉其中一顶后，它就可能再次成为选项。甚至可以先完成{#2}积攒50000克朗{/#2}，再完成{#3}积攒10000克朗{/#3}。

units.source: However, there are a fair number of ambitions that can end up unobtainable. Some just have requirements, like a maximum number of contracts completed, that can never be reduced in campaign once exceeded. Others, the game will {#1}permanently{/#1} mark as already completed if certain conditions are met. This check is only ever carried out immediately prior to the display of the ambition selection screen. No rewards are received for auto-completing an ambition this way, but it will unlock any other ambitions that have this ambition as a prerequisite.
units.zh: 不过，也有不少抱负可能永久错过。有些条件设定了累计完成委托数量等上限，一旦超过，就无法在本局中降回去。另一些抱负会在满足特定条件后，被游戏{#1}永久{/#1}标记为已完成。这项检查只在抱负选择界面出现前进行；以这种方式自动完成不会给予奖励，但会解锁以它为前置条件的其他抱负。

units.source: Care should be taken with the requirements for the {#1}{#2}following ambitions{/#2}{/#1}:
"We need allies. Forging a bond of friendship and trust with one of the towns will get the company better prices, more volunteers and more steady work."
units.zh: “我们需要盟友。与一座城镇建立友谊和信任，能为战团争取更好的价格、更多自愿加入的人，以及更稳定的工作。”

units.source: {#1}permanently{/#1} marked as already completed if, when ambition selection screen displayed, relations with any settlement or city-state are at 'Friendly' or higher
units.zh: 抱负选择界面出现时，若与任一聚落或城邦的关系已达到“友好”或更高，就会被{#1}永久{/#1}标记为已完成。

units.source: "We shall earn the trust of a noble house and become their ally. Surely they will share the fruits of their well-stocked armories with good friends."
units.zh: “我们要赢得一个贵族家族的信任，成为他们的盟友。他们一定愿意把军械库里的好东西，分享给真正的朋友。”

units.source: 'Open' or higher relations with at least one noble house
units.zh: 与至少一个贵族家族的关系达到“接纳”或更高。

units.source: "We shall outfit a contingent of at least three men with heavy armor to act as a bulwark against dangerous opponents."
units.zh: “我们要让至少三名兄弟穿上重甲，组成抵御强敌的坚固防线。”

units.source: have at most 2 pieces of armor and 2 helmets with 230 durability or more
units.zh: 耐久达到 230 或以上的身体护甲最多 2 件，头盔最多 2 顶。

units.source: "We can barely carry any more equipment or spoils of war. Let us save up 7,500 crowns to buy us a cart and relieve our backs!"
units.zh: “装备和战利品快要背不动了。攒下 7,500 克朗买辆手推车，让大家的背歇一歇！”

units.source: "If we can win this war for one of the noble houses, our name will be unmatched. Let us pick a side, bask in the glory of battle and get rich for it!"
units.zh: “若能帮助某个贵族家族赢得这场战争，我们的名声将无人能及。选定阵营，赢取战功，再大赚一笔！”

units.source: status of the crisis is visible: "Just started", "Raging", "Dragging On", "Almost Over"
units.zh: 可查看危机阶段：“刚刚开始”“战火正炽”“久拖不决”或“即将结束”。

units.source: only available during the {#1}War of the Noble Houses{/#1} late game crisis
units.zh: 仅在后期危机{#1}贵族战争{/#1}期间可选。

units.source: "Wild beasts beset villages on the fringes of civilization. Hunting them down for a profit is what we shall be doing!"
units.zh: “文明边缘的村庄正遭受野兽侵扰。猎杀它们、赚取报酬，就是我们接下来要做的事！”

units.source: Defeat 5 packs of roving beasts in battle, such as {#1}Direwolves{/#1} or {#2}Nachzehrers{/#2}, whether as part of a contract or by seeking them out on your own.
units.zh: 在战斗中击败 5 群游荡的野兽，例如{#1}恐狼{/#1}或{#2}食尸鬼{/#2}。可以通过委托猎杀，也可以自行寻找。

units.source: must have completed an ambition, unless {#1}Beast Slayers{/#1} company origin
units.zh: 必须已完成一个抱负；{#1}猎兽者{/#1}起源除外。

units.source: "Only the most daring take on goblins in larger numbers. We shall burn some of their fetid camps to the ground, and word of it will travel!"
units.zh: “只有最勇敢的人，才敢挑战成群地精。我们要把它们那些臭气熏天的营地烧成灰，让这件事传遍四方！”

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Goblin Trophy{/#4} (grants immunity to being rooted by nets or grasping vines)
"The Greenskin Invasion is threatening to sweep away our world. We shall stand strong and fend it off, for this is how legends are born!"
units.zh: “绿皮入侵正威胁着整个世界。我们要挺身而出，挡住它们——传奇正是这样诞生的！”

units.source: status of the crisis is visible: "Losing", "Undecided", "Winning Slightly", "Winning"
units.zh: 可查看危机战况：“处于败势”“胜负未定”“略占上风”或“胜利在望”。

units.source: only available during the {#1}Greenskin Invasion{/#1} late game crisis
units.zh: 仅在后期危机{#1}绿皮入侵{/#1}期间可选。

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} End the war between north and south{#4/}{#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Blazing Deserts DLC{/#8}
"The fires of religious turmoil threaten to engulf the lands. Let the company be forged stronger than ever by its heat and flames, and earn a fortune by winning the war!"
units.zh: “宗教纷争的烈火正吞噬大地。让战团在战火中锻造得更加强大，赢下战争，也赢得财富！”

units.source: only available during the {#1}Holy War{/#1} late game crisis
units.zh: 仅在后期危机{#1}圣战{/#1}期间可选。

units.source: "There are rumors about a colossal beast that lurks in the swamps. If we find and slay it, eternal fame will be our reward!"
units.zh: “传闻沼泽里潜伏着一头庞然巨兽。若能找到并杀死它，我们将获得永不磨灭的名声！”

units.source: Defeat a {#1}Kraken{/#1} in battle. You'll find it somewhere out there, in the wild.
units.zh: 在战斗中击败一只{#1}克拉肯{/#1}。它藏在某处荒野之中，等待你去寻找。

units.source: {#1}permanently{/#1} marked as already completed if, when ambition selection screen displayed, all above requirements are met and a Kraken has already been slain this campaign
units.zh: 抱负选择界面出现时，若满足上述全部条件，且本局已经杀死过克拉肯，就会被{#1}永久{/#1}标记为已完成。

units.source: "The best way to prove that we are the strongest company around is to defeat another mercenary band in battle!"
units.zh: “要证明我们是这一带最强的战团，最好的办法就是在战场上击败另一支佣兵团！”

units.source: "Besting orcs in battle and burning down some of their camps would make people recognize the company's ability on the battlefield. Let us do so!"
units.zh: “在战场上击败兽人，再烧掉他们几处营地，就能让世人见识我们战团的本领。动身吧！”

units.source: "The Undead are rising all over the lands, killing and devouring at sight. We need to put an end to this, or soon there will be no world as we know it left!"
units.zh: “亡灵在各地苏醒，见人就杀，逢人就噬。我们必须阻止它们，否则用不了多久，熟悉的世界就会毁于一旦！”

units.source: only available during the {#1}Undead Scourge{/#1} late game crisis
units.zh: 仅在游戏后期的{#1}亡灵灾祸{/#1}危机期间可选。

units.source: "The walking dead are a terrible curse upon man. Let us burn some of their lairs to the ground and earn the respect of all decent folk!"
units.zh: “行尸走肉是人类可怕的灾祸。我们去烧毁几处亡灵巢穴，赢得所有良善之人的敬重吧！”

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Undead Trophy{/#4} (unit's Resolve is doubled when defending against fear and mind control)
units.zh: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}亡灵战利品项链{/#4}（佩戴者抵抗恐惧和精神控制时，意志翻倍）

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} Discover all legendary locations in the world{#4/}{#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Beasts & Exploration DLC{/#8}
"Places of legend dot the world, hiding wonderous secrets within. Let's not rest until we've found every last one of them!"
units.zh: “世界各地散落着传说中的遗迹，其中藏着不可思议的秘密。不找齐所有地方，我们就决不罢休！”

units.source: Discover all {#1}legendary treasures{/#1} that exist in the world by going off on your own and exploring the wilds. Make sure to stock up on provisions before heading out!
units.zh: 自行探索荒野，发现世界上所有{#1}传奇宝藏{/#1}。出发前记得备足口粮！

units.source: at least 1 undiscovered legendary location remaining in the world
units.zh: 世界上至少还剩 1 处未发现的传奇地点。

units.source: "Great explorers become men of legend. Going into the wild lands is a dangerous business, but the tales we'll tell afterward will surely increase our renown."
units.zh: “伟大的探险家终将成为传奇。深入荒野固然危险，但回来后有了值得传颂的故事，我们的声望也必将提高。”

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} Discover 3 legendary locations by exploring the world{#4/}{#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Beasts & Exploration DLC{/#8}
"The wilds are teeming with hidden treasures that others are not bold enough to claim. This is our chance, so let us head out there and find three legendary places!"
units.zh: “荒野里藏着无数宝藏，只是旁人没有胆量去拿。我们的机会来了，出发去找出三处传奇地点吧！”

units.source: Discover 3 {#1}legendary locations{/#1} by going off on your own and exploring the world. Make sure to stock up on provisions before heading out!
units.zh: 自行探索世界，发现 3 处{#1}传奇地点{/#1}。出发前记得备足口粮！

units.source: at least 4 undiscovered legendary locations remaining in the world
units.zh: 世界上至少还剩 4 处未发现的传奇地点。

units.source: "Let us set out into the wilderness, discover the unknown, and plunder it. Be it a wizard's tomb, goblin camp, or aught else we may find."
units.zh: “我们去荒野中探寻未知，把找到的东西洗劫一空。不管是巫师的陵墓、地精的营地，还是别的什么，都别放过。”

units.source: contracts to destroy a location cannot complete this ambition
units.zh: 摧毁地点的委托不能用于完成这一抱负。

units.source: most recent destroyed location must have been the target of a contract
units.zh: 最近摧毁的地点必须是某份委托的目标。

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} Fulfill 5 contracts for the city states{#4/}{#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Blazing Deserts DLC{/#8}
"The city states of the south have crowns aplenty. We shall get rich under the blazing desert sun!"
units.zh: “南方城邦有的是克朗。我们就在沙漠的烈日下发一笔财！”

units.source: less than 16 contracts have been completed for the southern city-states during the campaign
units.zh: 本次战役中为南方城邦完成的委托少于 16 份。

units.source: "Our company is ill-prepared to fight armored opponents. We shall train two men to master the hammer in combat, and no knight will be safe from us."
units.zh: “我们还没准备好对付重甲敌人。先培养两名精通战锤的弟兄，让骑士们再也不敢小瞧我们。”

units.source: no more than 1 brother with a hammer mastery perk
units.zh: 拥有战锤精通特长的弟兄不超过 1 人。

units.source: "I know you are weary of our bad fortune and the stale fare day after day. We shall get food and drink from all over the land and have a feast!"
units.zh: “我知道大家受够了霉运，也吃腻了日复一日的陈粮。我们去搜罗各地的美酒佳肴，痛痛快快地吃一顿！”

units.source: Have one of each {#1}provision type{/#1} there is in your stash to hold a feast.
units.zh: 在行囊中备齐每一种{#1}口粮{/#1}，即可举办宴会。

units.source: all brothers get "Feasted with the company" {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} mood increase
units.zh: 全体弟兄获得“与战团一同赴宴”的{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}心情提升。

units.source: the average mood state of your brothers must be {#1}Dissatisfied{/#1} or worse
units.zh: 弟兄们的平均心情必须为{#1}心怀不满{/#1}或更差。

units.source: do not already carry all the required provision types
units.zh: 尚未携带齐全所有要求的口粮种类。

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} Have at least 6 armors with attachments{#4/}{#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Beasts & Exploration DLC{/#8}
"Mundane armors won't do for a real mercenary outfit. We should adorn our gear with trophies of our deeds!"
units.zh: “真正的佣兵战团怎能只穿寻常护甲？我们该把战利品缀在装备上，展示自己的功绩！”

units.source: {#1}permanently{/#1} marked as already completed if, when ambition selection screen displayed, all above requirements are met and the company owns 7 or more armors with attachments
units.zh: 打开抱负选择界面时，若满足上述所有条件，且战团已拥有至少 7 件装有附件的护甲，此抱负会被{#1}永久{/#1}标记为已完成。

units.source: "Should a battle or two go against us we may find ourselves out of pocket and short of equipment. The company will therefore build a reserve of 10,000 crowns."
units.zh: “要是连打几场败仗，我们可能会钱袋见底、装备短缺。因此，战团必须攒下 10,000 克朗备用。”

units.source: {#1}Make Nobles Aware{/#1} ambition is completed, unless {#2}Trading Caravan{/#2} company origin
units.zh: 已完成{#1}引起贵族注意{/#1}抱负；{#2}贸易商队{/#2}起源不受此条件限制。

units.source: "Crowns mean power and influence, and we can never have enough of either. Let us gather 50,000 crowns and earn our seat amongst noblemen and kings!"
units.zh: “克朗就是权力和影响力，多多益善。我们要攒下 50,000 克朗，让自己有资格与贵族和国王平起平坐！”

units.source: {#1}Have 10000 Crowns{/#1} ambition is completed, unless have more than 10,000 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}
"Already we are known in some parts of the land, yet we are still far from being a legendary company. We shall increase our renown further!"
units.zh: “我们虽已在一些地方小有名气，却离传奇战团还差得远。继续提高声望吧！”

units.source: {#1}permanently{/#1} marked as already completed if, when ambition selection screen displayed, all above requirements are met and the company has at least 2,650 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}
units.zh: 打开抱负选择界面时，若满足上述所有条件，且战团已拥有至少 2,650 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}，此抱负会被{#1}永久{/#1}标记为已完成。

units.source: "There were few legendary mercenary companies throughout history. We are close to having our name become immortal and be counted among them!"
units.zh: “历史上能称为传奇的佣兵战团屈指可数。如今，我们也快要跻身其中，让自己的名字流芳后世！”

units.source: company's look on the worldmap will be updated, unless {#1}Beast Slayers{/#1} or {#2}Gladiators{/#2} or {#3}Lone Wolf{/#3} or {#4}Manhunters{/#4} company origin
units.zh: 战团在世界地图上的外观会改变；{#1}猎兽者{/#1}、{#2}角斗士{/#2}、{#3}孤狼{/#3}和{#4}捕奴者{/#4}起源除外。

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} Have a character with three times three talent stars{#4/}{#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Blazing Deserts DLC{/#8}
"We need real talent to bolster our ranks further. We'll recruit the most talented we can find and mold him into a god of war!"
units.zh: “要继续壮大队伍，我们需要真正的人才。找到最有天赋的人，把他培养成战神！”

units.source: must have at least 2 spots open in the roster
units.zh: 队伍必须至少还有 2 个空位。

units.source: no brother has three different attributes with three talent stars
units.zh: 队伍中尚无三项不同属性均为三星天赋的弟兄。

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} Hire someone for your retinue of non-combat followers{#4/}{#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Blazing Deserts DLC{/#8}
"There are cooks, scouts and many more who can support us off the battlefield. We'll hire one that suits our needs best!"
units.zh: “厨师、斥候，还有许多其他人，都能在战场之外帮上忙。我们挑一个最合用的雇下来！”

units.source: {#1}permanently{/#1} marked as already completed if, when ambition selection screen displayed, all above requirements are met and there is already a follower in your retinue
units.zh: 打开抱负选择界面时，若满足上述所有条件，且已雇有随从，此抱负会被{#1}永久{/#1}标记为已完成。

units.source: "We need to catch the eye of one of the noble houses for more profitable work. They play their own dangerous game, but what does it matter as long as the pay is good?"
units.zh: “想接到报酬更高的活，就得引起某个贵族家族的注意。他们之间的勾心斗角固然危险，但只要钱给够，又有什么关系？”

units.source: {#1}permanently{/#1} marked as already completed if, when ambition selection screen displayed, all above requirements are met and a {#2}late game crisis{/#2} has begun and the company has at least 1,050 {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}
units.zh: 打开抱负选择界面时，若满足上述所有条件，且{#2}后期危机{/#2}已经开始、战团拥有至少 1,050 {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}，此抱负会被{#1}永久{/#1}标记为已完成。

units.source: "We need to establish ourselves as mercenaries that can be relied on. Let us be tested over and over to prove it without doubt!"
units.zh: “我们得让人相信，这是一支靠得住的佣兵队伍。一次次完成委托，用事实证明这一点！”

units.source: {#1}permanently{/#1} marked as already completed if, when ambition selection screen displayed, all above requirements are met and 15 or more contracts have already been completed during the campaign
units.zh: 打开抱负选择界面时，若满足上述所有条件，且本次战役中已完成至少 15 份委托，此抱负会被{#1}永久{/#1}标记为已完成。

units.source: "A respectable company is recognized by their equipment. We should head out and claim either a famed weapon, shield, armor or helmet to increase our renown."
units.zh: “体面的战团，光看装备就认得出来。我们该去弄到一件名贵武器、盾牌、护甲或头盔，提高自己的声望。”

units.source: Have at least 1 {#1}famed piece of equipment{/#1} in your possession - weapon, shield, armor or helmet. Follow rumors in taverns to learn where famed items can be found, purchase them at specialized shops in large cities and castles, or go out on your own to explore and raid ruins and camps. The further away from civilization, the higher the chance of finding rare items.
units.zh: 拥有至少 1 件{#1}名贵装备{/#1}，武器、盾牌、护甲或头盔均可。在酒馆打听传闻，可以获知名贵装备的下落；也可以去大城市和城堡的专门商店购买，或自行探索荒野、扫荡遗迹和营地。离人烟越远，找到稀有装备的机会就越大。

units.source: {#1}permanently{/#1} marked as already completed if, when ambition selection screen displayed, all above requirements are met and a famed item is in the company's possession
units.zh: 打开抱负选择界面时，若满足上述所有条件，且战团已拥有名贵装备，此抱负会被{#1}永久{/#1}标记为已完成。

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} Have a famed weapon, shield, armor and helmet{#4/}{#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Warriors of the North DLC{/#8}
"A famed company is recognized by their equipment. We should head out and claim a prestigious weapon, shield, armor and helmet to increase our renown."
units.zh: “声名显赫的战团，光看装备就认得出来。我们该去集齐名贵武器、盾牌、护甲和头盔，让名声更上一层楼。”

units.source: Have at least one {#1}famed weapon, shield, armor and helmet{/#1} each in your possession. Follow rumors in taverns to learn where famed items can be found, purchase them at specialized shops in large cities and castles, or go out on your own to explore and raid ruins and camps. The further away from civilization, the higher the chance of finding rare items.
units.zh: {#1}名贵武器、盾牌、护甲和头盔{/#1}各拥有至少一件。在酒馆打听传闻，可以获知名贵装备的下落；也可以去大城市和城堡的专门商店购买，或自行探索荒野、扫荡遗迹和营地。离人烟越远，找到稀有装备的机会就越大。

units.source: company does not own a famed weapon or a famed shield or a famed armor or a famed helmet
units.zh: 战团尚未集齐名贵武器、名贵盾牌、名贵护甲和名贵头盔。

units.source: "We need a battle standard so that we're recognized from afar! Having one be made is costly, so we shall gather 2,000 crowns for this."
units.zh: “我们需要一面战旗，让人远远就能认出我们！制作战旗要花不少钱，先为此攒下 2,000 克朗吧。”

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Battle Standard{/#4} (allies at a range of 4 tiles or less receive 10% of the Resolve of the character holding this standard as a bonus, up to a maximum of the standard bearer's Resolve)
units.zh: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}战旗{/#4}（距离不超过 4 格的友军获得意志加成，数值为持旗者意志的 10%；获得加成后的意志最高不超过持旗者的意志）

units.source: "There are lots of riches to be claimed from caravans. We need but take them like fruit from a tree!"
units.zh: “商队载着大把财富等着我们去取。伸手摘下，就像采树上的果子一样！”

units.source: must have raided a trade or supply caravan, unless {#1}Northern Raiders{/#1} company origin
units.zh: 必须曾劫掠贸易商队或补给车队；{#1}北境劫掠者{/#1}起源不受此条件限制。

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} Have 3 men with the bow or crossbow mastery perk
units.zh: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} 拥有 3 名具备弓精通或弩精通特长的弟兄

units.source: "The company lacks competent archers, limiting our tactical options. We shall train three men to master bow or crossbow and be deadly from afar!"
units.zh: “战团缺少合格的射手，战术选择也受了限制。我们要培养三名精通弓弩的弟兄，让他们能在远处取敌性命！”

units.source: no more than 2 brothers with a bow or crossbow mastery perk
units.zh: 拥有弓精通或弩精通特长的弟兄不超过 2 人。

units.source: "We shall get the company strength to a dozen men! It will make us a formidable force and will allow us to take on more profitable work."
units.zh: “我们要把战团扩充到十二人！这样就能成为一支令人忌惮的力量，承接报酬更高的活。”

units.source: must have completed an ambition, unless {#1}Deserters{/#1} or {#2}Northern Raiders{/#2} origin
units.zh: 必须已完成一项抱负；{#1}逃兵{/#1}和{#2}北境劫掠者{/#2}起源不受此条件限制。

units.source: {#1}permanently{/#1} marked as already completed if, when ambition selection screen displayed, all above requirements are met and the company already has 12 or more brothers
units.zh: 打开抱负选择界面时，若满足上述所有条件，且战团已有至少 12 名弟兄，此抱负会被{#1}永久{/#1}标记为已完成。

units.source: "We shall get the company strength to sixteen men! It will make us a formidable force and will allow us to take on more profitable work."
units.zh: “我们要把战团扩充到十六人！这样就能成为一支令人忌惮的力量，承接报酬更高的活。”

units.source: {#1}permanently{/#1} marked as already completed if, when ambition selection screen displayed, all above requirements are met and the company already has 16 or more brothers
units.zh: 打开抱负选择界面时，若满足上述所有条件，且战团已有至少 16 名弟兄，此抱负会被{#1}永久{/#1}标记为已完成。

units.source: "Let's build up our numbers to twenty good men so that the wounded may rest and the weary regain their strength between skirmishes."
units.zh: “我们要招满二十名好汉。这样每次交战后，伤员就能安心养伤，疲惫的人也能恢复体力。”

units.source: {#1}permanently{/#1} marked as already completed if, when ambition selection screen displayed, all above requirements are met and the company already has 20 or more brothers
units.zh: 打开抱负选择界面时，若满足上述所有条件，且战团已有至少 20 名弟兄，此抱负会被{#1}永久{/#1}标记为已完成。

units.source: "We fight well, but we need to be better organized in case things get dire. I shall name a sergeant to rally you on the battlefield."
units.zh: “我们打得不错，但要应对险境，还得更有组织。我会任命一名军士，在战场上鼓舞大家。”

units.source: Have at least one man with the {#1}'Rally the Troops'{/#1} perk. You'll also need space enough in your inventory for a new item.
units.zh: 至少拥有一名具备{#1}“重振士气”{/#1}特长的弟兄。行囊中还需要留出足够空间，放下新获得的物品。

units.source: "Nothing commands respect as a trophy of a giant beast of the frozen wastes. Let's go hunt and get the taxidermist some work!"
units.zh: “没有什么比冰封荒原巨兽的战利品更能赢得敬畏了。我们去狩猎，给标本师找点活干！”

units.source: Have at least 12 items crafted from {#1}beast trophies{/#1} at the {#2}taxidermist{/#2}. A taxidermist can be found in settlements mostly near woods and swamp, and can craft useful items from trophies dropped by beasts, such as the unusually large wolf pelts dropped by {#3}direwolves{/#3}.
units.zh: 在{#2}剥制工坊{/#2}处用{#1}野兽战利品{/#1}制作至少 12 件物品。标本师大多出现在森林或沼泽附近的聚落，可以用野兽掉落的战利品制作实用物品，例如{#3}恐狼{/#3}掉落的特大狼皮。

units.source: {#1}permanently{/#1} marked as already completed if, when ambition selection screen displayed, all above requirements are met and 12 or more items have already been crafted at the taxidermist
units.zh: 打开抱负选择界面时，若满足上述所有条件，且已在标本师处制作至少 12 件物品，此抱负会被{#1}永久{/#1}标记为已完成。

units.source: "There's lots of crowns to be made with trading between towns. Let's earn us a fortune!"
units.zh: “往来城镇做买卖能赚不少克朗。我们也去大赚一笔！”

units.source: must have completed an ambition, unless {#1}Trading Caravan{/#1} company origin
units.zh: 必须已完成一项抱负；{#1}贸易商队{/#1}起源不受此条件限制。

units.source: "I know the soles of your feet are itchy for the open road, and we need to spread word about the company. Let us pay visit to every settlement far and wide!"
units.zh: “我知道大家早就想上路了，我们也得把战团的名声传出去。走吧，去拜访四方的每一处聚落！”

units.source: "A cart to carry our things is fine and all, but it won't do. Let's save up 15,000 crowns and buy us a real wagon!"
units.zh: “小车运东西还算方便，但已经不够用了。攒下 15,000 克朗，买辆像样的大篷车吧！”

units.source: "Imagine the trail of terror we could blaze if your skills matched your bravery. We shall train five men to master their weapons so that they may act as a vanguard!"
units.zh: “要是你们的本领能配得上胆量，所到之处必会让敌人闻风丧胆。我们要培养五名精通武器的弟兄，让他们充当前锋！”

units.source: no more than 2 brothers with a weapon mastery perk
units.zh: 拥有武器精通类特长的弟兄不超过 2 人。

units.source: "Let us set aside skirmishes for now and seek to defeat a group of at least a dozen opponents. That is how our name will become known throughout the land!"
units.zh: “先别打小仗了，我们要找一支至少十二人的敌军，将其击败。只有这样，才能让我们的名号传遍四方！”

units.source: the most recent victory was against less than 12 enemies
units.zh: 最近一场胜仗中的敌人少于 12 名。

units.source: "We achieved some renown, but now you can see real fame on the horizon. Let us defeat a formidable force of two dozen opponents in battle!"
units.zh: “我们虽已有些声望，但真正的盛名就在眼前。去击败一支二十四人的强敌，让大家见识我们的本领！”

units.source: the most recent victory was against less than 24 enemies
units.zh: 最近一场胜仗中的敌人少于 24 名。

units.source: "Let us seek fame and fortune fighting before crowds that chant our names. We'll draw blood in the arenas of the south!"
units.zh: “让我们在高呼自己名字的观众面前厮杀，赢取名望和财富。去南方的竞技场，杀个痛快！”

units.source: must have completed an ambition, unless {#1}Gladiators{/#1} company origin
units.zh: 必须已完成一项抱负；{#1}角斗士{/#1}起源不受此条件限制。

units.source: Here you can see a list of the buildings which can appear in a settlement.
units.zh: 以下列出了聚落中可能出现的建筑。

units.source: Alchemy is an important part of the medieval ages' science, and rulers of the magnificent city states have always been patrons of it.
units.zh: 炼金术是中世纪科学的重要组成部分，宏伟城邦的统治者也一直是炼金术的资助者。

units.source: The {#1}alchemist{/#1} is always ready to offer a variety of exotic and dangerous alchemical contraptions at a reasonable price.
units.zh: {#1}炼金工坊{/#1}随时备有各种奇异而危险的炼金器具，价格也算公道。

units.source: {#1}Arena{/#1} fights is a deadly entertainment for the masses, and while some southerners fight for the prestige and cheer of the crowd, others do so unwillingly. Once a battle starts and you won’t be able to retreat.
units.zh: {#1}竞技场{/#1}以致命的搏杀供大众取乐。有的南方人为了声望和观众的欢呼而战，有的则被迫上场。战斗一旦开始，便无法撤退。

units.source: Arena battles are fought on a smaller map than regularly, and you’re limited to fight with just three men of your choice against various opponents. You’ll know exactly which and how many opponents you’re about to face. And if the upcoming arena match is not to your liking, you can simply wait until the next day and the next arena match.
units.zh: 竞技场地图比普通战场小，你只能选派三名弟兄，迎战各式对手。开战前，你会清楚知道敌人的种类和数量。如果不想打眼前这一场，可以等到第二天换一场比赛。

units.source: Every fifth arena match is a special one; you’ll face harder opposition than usual. If you manage to win, you will earn a piece of rare gladiator equipment not otherwise available in the game.
units.zh: 每第五场竞技赛都是特殊场次，敌人比平时更强。获胜后可得到一件稀有的角斗士装备，这类装备无法通过其他方式获得。

units.source: Hiring a {#1}Surgeon{/#1} for your {#2}retinue{/#2} of non-combat followers may be a good investment to ensure that your men survive after a lost battle to entertain the crowd for another day.
units.zh: 为不参战的{#2}随从{/#2}雇用一名{#1}外科医生{/#1}，或许是笔划算的投资：他能帮助弟兄们在落败后保住性命，改日再为观众献上一场角斗。

units.source: Offer high quality armor and a variety of shield types at full durability. Not cheap. Typical prices here are about 25% higher than a similar item in the Market. Can instantly repair items (Hold Alt and click an item), without using the party's tool supply, but at a costly price (heavily depends on the item's worth value).
units.zh: 出售耐久全满的优质护甲和各类盾牌，价格不菲，通常比市场上的同类物品贵约 25%。还可立即修理物品：按住 Alt 并点击物品即可。修理不消耗战团的工具，但费用高昂，主要取决于物品本身的价值。

units.source: Cuts hair and beards. Here you can change the appearance of your brothers, even their scars.
units.zh: 提供理发和修胡须服务。可以改变弟兄们的外貌，连伤疤也能调整。

units.source: Produces all sorts of ranged weapons: {#1}bows{/#1}, {#2}crossbows{/#2}, {#3}javelins{/#3}, {#4}throwing axes{/#4}. Also offers a variety of {#5}ammunition{/#5} and quivers. Price modifiers for items here are about 25% higher than the corresponding settlement {#6}Market{/#6}
units.zh: 制作各类远程武器：{#1}弓类{/#1}、{#2}弩类{/#2}、{#3}标枪{/#3}和{#4}飞斧{/#4}，也出售各种{#5}弹药{/#5}及箭袋。这里的物品价格系数比同一聚落的{#6}市场{/#6}高约 25%。

units.source: From the docks here, you can instantly travel to the ports of other settlements. Not for free of course. There is a base price for each port (determined by distance), which is multiplied by the number of men in the party (and likely truncated to nearest 10) to give the final price. Prices of a few hundred crowns are typical.
units.zh: 从码头可以立即乘船前往其他聚落的港口，当然需要付费。每个目的地都有一个由距离决定的基础票价，再乘以队伍人数得到总价；原文推测，结果还会向下取整到最接近的 10 克朗。一般需要几百克朗。

units.source: {#1}Dogs{/#1} in all variety. Want to adopt a nice puppy? Not here. Only bloodthirsty and savage battle dogs that chew goblins for breakfast.
units.zh: 出售各种{#1}战犬{/#1}。想领养一只可爱的小狗？这里没有。这里只有凶猛嗜血、能把地精当早餐嚼碎的战犬。

units.source: The Market square. Buy all sorts of things including {#1}tools{/#1}, {#2}medicine{/#2}, {#3}food{/#3}, {#4}weapons{/#4} and {#5}armor{/#5}. Weapons and armor below full durability are sold here as well (at reduced prices, proportional to remaining durability). Barring caravans and special {#6}settlement situations{/#6}, the selection of market items usually refreshes every 3 days. Completing some contracts refreshes the assortment as well.
units.zh: 在市场广场可以买到{#1}工具{/#1}、{#2}药品{/#2}、{#3}食物{/#3}、{#4}武器{/#4}和{#5}护甲{/#5}等各类物品，也有耐久不满的武器和护甲，价格会按剩余耐久比例降低。若不受商队和特殊{#6}城镇状况{/#6}影响，市场通常每 3 天补充一次商品。完成某些委托也会刷新货品。

units.source: This is where you {#1}hire{/#1} men who have decided to work as mercenaries. Is it because they lost their home, family or something else. You can offer them the opportunity to travel to far away places, to meet new people and other "{#2}things{/#2}".
units.zh: 在这里可以{#1}雇用{/#1}决心当佣兵的人。他们或许失去了家园、家人，也可能另有缘由。你能给他们一份工作，让他们远行，见识陌生人以及其他“{#2}东西{/#2}”。

units.source: The Tavern. Buy drinks to your soldiers to boost their {#1}morale{/#1}. But beware getting them {#2}drunk{/#2}, because that can get them easily killed in a battle - in addition to suffering a {#3}hangover{/#3} effect afterwards. Prices scale proportionally depending on the number of men, and are influenced by {#4}settlement situations{/#4} and {#5}relations{/#5}.
units.zh: 酒馆里可以请弟兄们喝酒，改善{#1}士气{/#1}。不过别让他们{#2}醉酒{/#2}：这不仅可能让他们在战斗中轻易丧命，之后还会带来{#3}宿醉{/#3}。酒钱随人数按比例增加，也受{#4}城镇状况{/#4}和{#5}关系{/#5}影响。

units.source: Also, you can get {#1}tavern rumors{/#1} here. Paying drinks for patrons can be repeated 4 times a visit for new rumors.
units.zh: 这里还可以打听{#1}酒馆传闻{/#1}。每次到访，最多可请客 4 次，以获取新的消息。

units.source: {#1}Taxidermist{/#1} allows the player to {#2}craft new items{/#2} out of {#3}trophies{/#3}.

Priests apply fresh bandages and pray for your wounded brothers to speed up their healing time for injuries, for a price of course. (Healing time reduced after paying, i.e.: 2-4 days to 1-2 days, 1-3 days to 1 day)
units.zh: 牧师会为受伤的弟兄更换绷带、祈祷，加快伤势恢复，当然也要收费。付款后，伤势的恢复时间会缩短，例如从 2-4 天缩至 1-2 天，或从 1-3 天缩至 1 天。

units.source: Veterans here help train your mercenaries in exchange for money, giving them a boost in experience gain over a few battles. Training price is mainly influenced by level of the trainee, increasing proportionally with added levels (e.g. Veteran's Lessons costs 253G for a L1 recruit and 1106G for a L10 fighter).
units.zh: 这里的老兵会收钱训练佣兵，使其在接下来的几场战斗中获得更多经验。费用主要取决于受训者的等级，等级越高，费用也相应增加。例如，“老兵课程”为 L1 新兵收费 253 克朗，为 L10 战士收费 1106 克朗。

units.source: Offers weapons of high quality at full durability. Sometimes unique ones, which will then have a special name. Not cheap. Price modifiers for items here are about 25% higher than the corresponding settlement Market. Can instantly repair items (Hold Alt and click an item), without using the party's tool supply, but at a costly price (heavily depends on the item's worth value).
units.zh: 出售耐久全满的优质武器，有时也会出现带有专属名字的独特武器。价格不菲，物品价格系数比同一聚落的市场高约 25%。还可立即修理物品：按住 Alt 并点击物品即可。修理不消耗战团的工具，但费用高昂，主要取决于物品本身的价值。

units.source: {#1}Settlements{/#1} can inherit different kinds of states. These are not limited to one at a time, as such a settlement can inherit multiple states at the same time.
units.zh: {#1}聚落{/#1}可能处于不同的状况，而且可以同时受到多种状况影响。

units.source: These states can affect the offered prices for {#1}trade{/#1} and other items, the availability of recruits, as well as being an indicator of which type of {#2}contract{/#2} this settlement is likely to have available. Percentages mentioned below (for states that affect trade) are applied multiplicatively (unless stated otherwise in table below) on base price modifiers for that settlement (ie a settlement that usually has a selling price modifier of 19.6% (all regular items sold at 19.6% of worth) will now have a selling price modifier of 21.6% in the event of Ambushed Trade Route (+10%)).
units.zh: 这些状况会影响{#1}贸易{/#1}及其他物品的价格、可招募人员的数量，也能提示该聚落可能提供哪类{#2}委托{/#2}。除下表另有说明外，影响贸易的百分比均乘算于聚落的基础价格系数。例如，某聚落平时按物品价值的 19.6% 收购物品，即出售价格系数为 19.6%；出现“商路遇袭”（+10%）后，该系数就会变为约 21.6%。

units.source: More item availability increases the chance of any item being offered. This also increases the chance for named items to be sold.
units.zh: 商品供应增加，会提高各类物品出现在商店中的概率，也会提高名贵装备的上架概率。

units.source: Less item availability decreases the chance of any item being offered. This also decreases the chance for named items to be sold or makes it even impossible.
units.zh: 商品供应减少，会降低各类物品出现在商店中的概率，也会降低名贵装备的上架概率，甚至使其完全无法出现。

units.source: A contest in archery has attracted anyone proficient with a bow. A good time, perhaps, to look for according recruits available.
units.zh: 射箭比赛吸引了各路弓箭好手。眼下或许正是招募射手的好时机。

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}+25%{/#4} recruits available.{#5/}{#6}Hunters{/#6}, {#7}Poachers{/#7}, {#8}Witchhunters{/#8}, {#9}Sellswords{/#9} or {#10}Beast Slayers{/#10} are more likely to be available for hire.
{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}+50%{/#4} food available{#5/}{#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} {#9}-10%{/#9} food prices{#10/}{#11}Gladiators{/#11} are more likely to be available for hire.

{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}+100%{/#4} selling prices for monster {#5}Trophies{/#5}{#6/}{#7}{#8}{#9/}{/#8}{/#7} {#10}+25%{/#10} recruits available. {#11}Anatomists{/#11}, {#12}Witchhunters{/#12} and {#13}Beast Slayers{/#13} are more likely to be available for hire.

There's a procession of cultists going through the city; a steady stream of people seemingly manifested themselves out of thin air and now slowly makes its way along the main roads. Clad in muted colors they ring bells and chant monotonously the name of Davkul.
units.zh: 一支邪教徒队伍正在城中游行。接连不断的人群仿佛凭空出现，沿着主干道缓慢前进。他们穿着颜色暗淡的衣服，摇响铃铛，单调地吟诵着达夫库尔之名。

units.source: {#1}Cultists{/#1} are more likely to be available for hire.
units.zh: {#1}邪教徒{/#1}更容易出现在招募名单中。

units.source: Villagers have been disappearing from this town, putting everyone on edge. Fewer potential recruits available are to be found on the streets, and people deal less favourably with strangers.
units.zh: 镇上不断有人失踪，人人惶恐不安。街上可供招募的人少了，居民对陌生人开出的交易条件也更苛刻。

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}−10%{/#4} buying prices{#5/}{#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} {#9}−10%{/#9} selling prices{#10/}{#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} {#14}+25%{/#14} recruits available{#15/}{#16}Deserters{/#16}, {#17}Militias{/#17}, {#18}Sellswords{/#18}, {#19}Retired Soldiers{/#19}, {#20}Squires{/#20} or {#21}Hedge Knights{/#21} are more likely to be available for hire.
{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}−50%{/#4} food available{#5/}{#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} {#9}+100%{/#9} food prices{#10/}{#11}Farmhands{/#11} are more likely to be available for hire.
A boat with fishermen has been lost at sea during a storm. Both fresh fish and willing recruits available are a rare sight.
units.zh: 一艘渔船连同船上的渔民在风暴中失踪。如今，新鲜鱼货和愿意应募的人都很少见。

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}+25%{/#4} recruits available.{#5/}{#6}Miners{/#6} are more likely to be available for hire.{#7/}{#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} {#11}Gemstones{/#11} and {#12}{#13}{#14/}{/#13}{/#12} {#15}Copper Ingots{/#15} are not available for sale.
Order has been given to muster troops for service in this settlement. Equipment and recruits available are in short supply, but a quick crown can be made by selling arms and armor here.
units.zh: 聚落接到征兵命令，正在集结部队。装备和可招募人员都很紧缺，但在此出售武器和护甲能迅速赚上一笔。

units.source: Only possible if permanent destruction option is turned off. A razed settlement has absolutely nothing to offer. This settlement will eventually return to its normal state. (verification needed)
units.zh: 仅在关闭聚落永久摧毁选项时出现。被夷为平地的聚落暂时无法提供任何东西，但最终会恢复正常。（原站标注：有待验证。）

units.source: With the war raging, a constant stream of refugees is pouring into this settlement. It puts a strain on local economy, but it also means cheap recruits available for anyone that can offer work.
units.zh: 战火蔓延，难民不断涌入这处聚落，给当地经济带来压力。不过，对能提供工作的人而言，这也意味着可以廉价招到人手。

units.source: A sickness has struck down many folks in this settlement. There are fewer recruits available available, and food and medical supplies are scarce.
units.zh: 疾病使聚落里的许多人倒下了。可招募的人手减少，食物和医疗物资也很紧缺。

units.source: The villagers here are terrified of unknown horrors. Fewer potential recruits available are to be found on the streets, and people deal less favourably with strangers.
units.zh: 村民们被未知的恐怖吓坏了。街上可供招募的人少了，居民对陌生人开出的交易条件也更苛刻。

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Gladiators{/#4} are more likely to be available for hire.
This place has been recently supplied with fresh wares, and many of those can now be bought for the right prices.
units.zh: 这里最近运来了一批新货，只要出得起合适的价钱，就能买到其中不少商品。

units.source: The {#1}Arena{/#1} is a place where you can fight in small battle and gain a large sum of crowns without the need of {#2}{#3}contracts{/#3}{/#2}. You can put up to three men for the fight. The fight is randomized, however, and might not always be entirely fair. The {#4}Arena{/#4} can be found in one of the {#5}{#6}Deserts Cities{/#6}{/#5} with the Blazing Deserts DLC. You can earn three traits; {#7}{#8}Pit Fighter{/#8}{/#7},{#9} {#10}Arena Fighter{/#10} {/#9}and {#11}{#12}Arena Veteran{/#12}{/#11}.
units.zh: 在{#1}竞技场{/#1}参加小规模战斗，无须接取{#2}{#3}委托{/#3}{/#2}也能赚取可观的克朗。每场最多派出三人，敌人随机生成，实力未必与你的队伍相当。安装烈日沙漠 DLC 后，可在一座{#5}{#6}沙漠城市{/#6}{/#5}找到{#4}竞技场{/#4}。参赛可获得三种特性：{#7}{#8}斗场新手{/#8}{/#7}、{#9}{#10}竞技勇士{/#10}{/#9}和{#11}{#12}竞技老将{/#12}{/#11}。

units.source: You may compete in the Arena once per day. It is worth noting that a new day begins in the Morning phase; the game considers Dawn to be part of the prior day. Therefore if you arrive at the city during the night, you can compete in the Arena once during Dawn, and a second time when it's Morning.
units.zh: 每天可参加一场竞技赛。新的竞技日从“上午”阶段开始，游戏仍把“黎明”算作前一天。因此，如果夜里到城，可以先在黎明打一场，到了上午再打一场。

units.source: Victory will reward you with gold, reputation, and the traits mentioned above. Every fifth win will require you to beat a harder than normal fight (1/3 higher difficulty rating than normal) and reward you with a piece of gladiator gear. These rewards are as follows.
units.zh: 获胜会获得金钱、声誉以及上述特性。每逢第五场胜利，必须先赢下一场更难的比赛，难度评分比普通场次高 1/3，并奖励一件角斗士装备。具体奖励如下。

units.source: Every 5 wins after 15: a random piece from the previous options
units.zh: 15 胜之后，每再赢 5 场：从上述装备中随机获得一件。

units.source: Note that the pool of potential enemies for these matches is the same as for all others. You will just fight more enemies due to the increased difficulty rating. The gear reward will wait for you until your next win, so you can and should skip difficult fights (eg., Gladiators, Hedge Knights) if you are not prepared, as you can always get the gear on a different day.
units.zh: 这些特殊场次使用的敌人候选池与普通场次相同，只因难度评分提高而增加敌人数目。装备奖励会一直保留到下一场胜利，所以准备不足时，可以跳过角斗士、流浪骑士等难打的对手，改日再赢取装备。

units.source: The potential enemies you can fight each day vary widely in difficulty, but the rewards only scale up by a very modest amount for the harder opponents. An experienced arena fighter should know when a fight is not worth it, at the cost of having to wait until the next day to try again. The Champion fights in particular give very poor rewards considering the extreme danger. It is possible to get weak opponents in the late game, and it's also possible to get extremely hard fights against opponents such as Hedge Knights and Swordmasters early on, so be sure to skip these unless you're feeling lucky (suicidal).
units.zh: 每天遇到的对手强弱差异很大，但困难场次的报酬只会小幅增加。有经验的竞技场战士应懂得判断哪些仗不值得打，代价只是等到第二天再试。尤其是精英对手，危险极高，奖励却很不划算。后期仍可能遇到弱敌，前期也可能碰上流浪骑士、剑术大师等极难对付的敌人。除非你想拿命赌运气，否则应当跳过这类场次。

units.source: There is a small list of generally weak opponents at the start, though they can still prove quite challenging for rosters without strongs bros and equipment. New potential enemies are unlocked with more wins in the arena (up to 15). The opponents for each day are picked from a weighted pool of all unlocked opponents. Some fights are more common than others, with many of the weaker opponents, and notably Gladiators, being the most common.
units.zh: 起初的敌人候选名单较短，整体实力也偏弱；但若队伍缺少强力弟兄和好装备，仍可能吃不消。随着竞技场胜场增加，会解锁更多敌人，直到 15 胜。每天的对手按权重从全部已解锁组合中抽取，某些场次更常出现；许多较弱的敌人，以及角斗士，出现频率尤其高。

units.source: The table gives numbers for normal fights. Every fifth win will require you to beat a harder than normal fight (1/3 higher difficulty rating than normal), meaning the enemy counts will increase by ~1/3 for those fights. This could differ significantly due to rounding, however. For instance, you might have to fight 2 lindwurms on fifth-win fights, whereas the max is normally 1. You can tell you're up for a harder fight when you're offered a piece of gladiator gear. All values in the table reflect Expert combat difficulty, which slightly increases enemy counts (Beginner = 0.85, Veteran = 1.0, Expert = 1.15).
units.zh: 下表列出普通场次的敌人数目。每第五场胜利对应的比赛会更难，难度评分提高 1/3，敌人数目也大约增加 1/3；但取整可能造成明显差异。例如，普通场次最多出现 1 条林德蠕龙，特殊场次却可能出现 2 条。若奖励中包含角斗士装备，就说明这是一场更难的比赛。表中数值均以“专家”战斗难度为准，其敌人数目会略有增加；难度系数分别为：初学者 0.85、老练 1.0、专家 1.15。

units.source: Once an opponent type is picked from those available based on the number of wins the player has achieved in the arena, the number of enemies is scaled with the factors described below. For the hardest opponents, only 1 will spawn in a match, but they may bring some allies with them to round out their numbers. Most fights simply spawn X of a single unit. Note that, due to hard minimums, some fights are barely affected by scaling. The champions, for instance, are at max or almost max difficulty even at minimum scaling.
units.zh: 游戏先根据玩家的竞技场胜场数确定已解锁的对手，再从中选取敌人类型，按下述因素调整人数。最强的对手每场只会出现 1 名，但可能带上同伴补足阵容。多数场次只是生成若干名同类敌人。由于人数存在硬性下限，有些场次几乎不受难度缩放影响。例如，精英场次即使按最低系数生成，也已经达到或接近最高难度。

units.source: Number of days passed + Arena victories is a minor factor, but it caps at 50 and will stop affecting scaling after this.
units.zh: 经过的天数与竞技场胜场数之和是次要因素；这一数值最多按 50 计算，超过后不再影响难度。

units.source: The main factor is roster strength. This is similar to contract scaling, and starts with the sum of [10 + 2*(lvl-1)] for each of the 12 highest-level brothers.
units.zh: 主要因素是队伍实力，计算方式与委托难度类似：取等级最高的 12 名弟兄，分别计算 [10 + 2*(等级-1)]，再将结果相加。

units.source: A multiplier of (12 / roster size) is also applied. This means you cannot get around scaling and force very easy fights by maintaining a small roster. This also rewards roster sizes larger than 12 with {#1}easier{/#1} fights.
units.zh: 随后再乘以（12 ÷ 队伍总人数）。因此，维持小队伍无法绕过难度缩放、强行刷出极简单的比赛；相反，队伍超过 12 人时，比赛会{#1}更容易{/#1}。

units.source: There is a min and max scaling from 0.75 to 5. Your final scaling value linearly adjusts the number of enemy mobs (outside of rounding and hard minimums, which significantly reduce the effect of scaling on some fights). Max requires an enormous amount of veteran levels, so most campaigns won't hit it (probably requires levels well above 20+ on 12 bros for full rosters that include 18+ bros. Origins that force 12 max roster will hit max scaling around lvl ~16 on all bros).
units.zh: 最终难度系数介于 0.75 和 5 之间，敌人数目随之线性变化；但取整和硬性人数下限会明显削弱部分场次的缩放效果。达到最高系数需要大量老兵等级，大多数战役都不会触及上限。原文估计：满编队伍若有 18 人以上，等级最高的 12 人可能都得远超 20 级；若起源限定队伍最多 12 人，则全员约 16 级便会达到上限。

units.source: If you are struggling with difficult arena fights in the mid to late game, consider filling your ranks up to max with indebted to make things easier. For example, having exactly 12 bros, with all at lvl 11, results in a difficulty factor of 3.9. Increasing the roster to 20 would reduce this to 2.6, and it could go all the way down to 2.2 at 25 bros. Note, however, that due to hardcoded minimums, this won't help that much in a lot of the hardest fights. Champion fights, for instance, are barely affected by scaling.
units.zh: 如果中后期的竞技赛太难，可以考虑招募负债者补满队伍，降低难度。例如，队伍恰有 12 人且全员 11 级时，难度系数为 3.9；扩充到 20 人可降至 2.6，达到 25 人时甚至能降至 2.2。不过，许多最难的比赛有硬性人数下限，这种办法帮助有限；例如精英场次几乎不受缩放影响。

units.source: You use five men instead of the regular three, it consists of three rounds with no chance to rest or change brothers and gear, but with a possibility to quit after each round. The earlier you quit, the lower the prize. The further you progress, the tougher the opponents. If you win the tournament you will get a {#1}named item{/#1}.
units.zh: 锦标赛可派五人，而非普通比赛的三人。比赛共三轮，轮间无法休息，也不能更换弟兄或装备，但每轮结束后可以退出。退出越早，奖金越低；晋级越深，对手越强。赢得锦标赛后会获得一件{#1}名贵装备{/#1}。

units.source: Arena fights and tournaments are timed so you need to enter the Arena the same day you accepted the challenge, otherwise it is considered a failed contract. However you can cancel it, before starting, like a regular contract.
units.zh: 普通竞技赛和锦标赛都有时限，必须在接受挑战的当天入场，否则会被视为委托失败。不过，在开战之前，仍可像普通委托一样取消挑战。

units.source: In either case, it pays to be prepared. A visit to the alchemist before a particularly hard fight, switching gear and brothers around to counter a specific opponent and using nets to control engagements will help you survive a lot longer in the pits.
units.zh: 无论参加哪类比赛，充分准备都很有帮助。遇到强敌前先去炼金术士处采购，根据对手调整人员和装备，并用捕网控制交战局面，都能提高在斗坑中的生存机会。

City States are a type of Human factions in Battle Brothers. Southern city states send regiments to patrol surroundings, and caravans to trade with other settlements. Caravans are guarded by their melee units, usually {#1}Conscripts{/#1}. Southerners are hostile to {#2}Noble Houses{/#2} during the Holy War.
units.zh: 城邦是《战场兄弟》中的一种人类势力。南方城邦会派遣军队巡逻周边，也会派商队与其他聚落贸易。商队由近战部队护卫，通常是{#1}征召兵{/#1}。圣战期间，南方人与{#2}贵族家族{/#2}互为敌对。

units.source: Life is cheap in the south, as the saying goes, and nothing makes this harsh reality sink in better than how the city states treat their slaves. In battle, they’re usually send first against the enemy to tire out their lines before the real battle begins. They’re poorly armed, many just carrying tools used as improvised weapons, and rely on swarming, flanking and overwhelming the enemy. They have poor morale and flee easily, but killing or breaking them does not affect the morale of any city state troops that aren’t slaves themselves. In fact, the city state troops have no qualms about friendly fire when it comes to slaves, and they may seize the opportunity that slaves provide by locking down the enemy and fire their ranged weapons into the thick of battle.
units.zh: 俗话说，南方人命贱。城邦对待奴隶的方式最能体现这一残酷现实。战斗中，奴隶通常最先冲向敌人，在主力交战前消耗敌军。他们装备简陋，许多人仅以工具充当武器，依靠蜂拥包围、侧翼夹击和人数优势作战。奴隶士气低，容易溃逃；但杀死或击溃他们，不会影响其他非奴隶城邦部队的士气。城邦军队甚至毫不顾忌误伤奴隶，常趁奴隶缠住敌人时，向混战中的人群倾泻远程火力。

units.source: Considerably better armed than Conscripts, Officers carry finely crafted mail and lamellar armor with intricate southern ornaments into battle. Naturally, all armors can also be bought, looted and worn by your own men in the game!
units.zh: 军官的装备远胜征召兵，身穿制作精良的锁甲和札甲，上面饰有繁复的南方纹样。当然，游戏中这些护甲都可以购买或缴获，交给自己的弟兄穿戴！

units.source: In battle, Assassins wear traditional black robes over finely crafted mail. Many also choose to exchange their own face for that of their master and founder of their cult, the old man on the mountain, by wearing metal face masks. Assassins have a nimble combat style and employ a variety of alchemical contraptions like Flash Pots and Smoke Pots to daze their opponents and move freely between them, only to then use a Qatal Dagger for greater impact on their debilitated victims.
units.zh: 刺客作战时会在精制锁甲外罩上传统黑袍。许多人还戴着金属面具，以教团创始人兼导师“山中老人”的面容代替自己的脸。刺客身法轻灵，会用闪光罐、烟雾罐等炼金器具使敌人恍惚，在敌阵间自由穿行，再以卡塔尔匕首重创受到削弱的目标。

units.source: Southern faction is among the strongest in the game. Their infantry has {#1}Nimble{/#1}, including polearm users. Their {#2}Gunners{/#2} lower your accuracy with {#3}Overwhelm{/#3}, making you less likely to hit their frontline, and they also hit your backline without penalty. Weapons like {#4}Swordlance{/#4} and {#5}Handgonne{/#5} do more damage to tight formations, while {#6}Backstabber{/#6} works against sparse formations. And there are also deadly {#7}Assassins{/#7} with their contraptions and {#8}Mortars{/#8} bombarding you.
units.zh: 南方势力是游戏中最强的势力之一。其步兵，包括长柄武器兵，都拥有{#1}轻灵{/#1}。{#2}火铳手{/#2}通过{#3}压制{/#3}降低你的命中率，使你更难打中前排，还能不受惩罚地攻击后排。{#4}长柄剑刃{/#4}和{#5}手铳{/#5}等武器善于打击密集阵型，而{#6}背刺者{/#6}又能克制分散站位。此外，还有带着炼金器具的致命{#7}刺客{/#7}，以及不断轰击你的{#8}臼炮{/#8}。

units.source: Southerners seem to not care about friendly fire, and will often hit their own troops with area attacks.
units.zh: 南方人似乎并不在意误伤，范围攻击经常连自己人一起打中。

units.source: Gilders are the denizens of the southern city states. Like the Northen Noble houses, their combat style is somewhat reminiscent of the legions of the {#1}Ancient Empire{/#1}. Gilder forces can be encountered through contracts during the Holy War, or by angering one of the city states and engaging them straight on the world map.
units.zh: 镀金者的信徒居住在南方城邦。他们与北方贵族家族的军队一样，战斗方式多少让人想起{#1}古代帝国{/#1}的军团。圣战期间，可以在委托中遭遇南方军队；也可以激怒某个城邦，直接在世界地图上与其交战。

units.source: Citizens of the great city states enjoy privileges that neither slaves nor outsiders do. For example, they have the opportunity to conduct business with the legal certainty of a codified law and can even hire legal council. In turn, they also have certain obligations to their state. Having to pay taxes is one such obligation, but another one for every adult male citizen is either mandatory military service or paying a hefty sum into the state’s coffers to be exempt. The council of Viziers may decide to conscript the citizens for the defense of the city state or for otherwise protecting and furthering the interests of the state. In practise, this can mean anything between border skirmishes with other states, doomed punitive expeditions deep into the deserts to hunt down raiders, and crushing slave rebellions.
units.zh: 宏伟城邦的公民享有奴隶和外来者没有的特权。例如，他们做生意时有成文法保障，甚至可以聘请法律顾问。作为交换，公民也必须对城邦履行义务。纳税是一项义务；成年男性还须服兵役，或向国库缴纳巨款以换取豁免。维齐尔议会可以征召公民保卫城邦，或维护、扩张城邦的利益。实际任务包罗万象：与邻国发生边境冲突，深入沙漠执行注定失败的剿匪远征，或镇压奴隶起义。

units.source: Conscripts make up the bulk of the military force of the city states. They have received some military drill and are most often dressed in a distinct southern armor made of several layers of linen, called a Linothorax, that is relatively cheap to produce. If they don’t have access to helmets, they choose to wrap cloth around their heads to protect against the sun. The color and patterns of these head wraps are often linked to a particular region of the south, and one familiar would know what place a southern conscript calls home by his headwear alone. Just before battle lines clash, Conscripts employ a unique weapon of the city states. It’s one reason why they are a military power to be reckoned with.
units.zh: 征召兵是城邦军队的主力，接受过一定的军事训练，通常穿着南方特有的亚麻胸甲。这种护甲由多层亚麻布制成，造价相对低廉。没有头盔的人会用布包头遮阳，头巾的颜色和花纹常对应南方某个地区；熟悉当地习俗的人，只看头巾便能知道征召兵的家乡。双方阵线即将碰撞时，征召兵会使用城邦特有的武器。这也是南方军力不容小觑的原因之一。

units.source: Officers of the city states are mostly made up of the wealthy who would have enough funds to buy themselves free of conscription, but seek a career commanding troops in the military by their own volition. A victorious commander will accrue influence and gravitas, and some Officers may consider the army but a stepping stone in a fledgling political career.
units.zh: 城邦军官大多家境富裕，原本有钱免除征召，却自愿从军，希望以统兵为业。获胜的指挥官会积累影响力与威望；对某些军官而言，军队不过是政治生涯起步时的一块跳板。

units.source: Members of a secretive ritualistic cult, Assassins deal in death and provide murder as a service. They have no political ambition beyond the continued survival of their cult and that of their warped philosophy, and so act only in service to other parties, like individual city states. They’re not encountered roaming on the world map, but exclusively as part of contracts and events.
units.zh: 刺客属于一个注重仪式的神秘教团，以取人性命为业，受雇杀人。他们没有其他政治野心，只求教团及其扭曲教义延续，因此只为城邦等外部势力效力。刺客不会在世界地图上游荡，只会在特定委托和事件中出现。

units.source: Ranged Weapons are used to deal damage to the enemy at a distance.
units.zh: 远程武器用于从远处对敌人造成伤害。

units.source: Each type of Ranged Weapon uses ammo from designated ammo source:
units.zh: 每种远程武器都有对应的弹药来源：

units.source: Crossbows and Handgonnes equipped in active weapon slots at the start of a battle are pre-loaded. Later, Crossbows and Handgonnes respectively require equipped quiver of bolts or gunpowder bag for reload.
units.zh: 战斗开始时，放在当前武器栏中的弩和手铳会预先装填。之后若要重新装填，弩必须配备弩矢袋，手铳则必须配备火药袋。

units.source: Projectile bundles of Throwing Weapons, ammo for quivers and gunpowder bags are automatically refilled after combat from global ammo stockpile.
units.zh: 战斗结束后，投掷武器、箭袋和火药袋都会从战团的公共弹药储备中自动补充。

units.source: Multiple quivers or gunpowder bags can easily be carried into battle as they have no fatigue penalty.
units.zh: 箭袋和火药袋不会造成疲劳惩罚，因此可以轻松携带多个进入战斗。

units.source: Slings use stones and, thus, have infinite ammo source. Slings don't require any bags or quivers as well.
units.zh: 投石索使用石块，弹药无限，也不需要箭袋或其他弹药袋。

units.source: Anyone ending their turn inside the burning area will catch fire and take damage - friend and foe alike.
