units.source: Defense has reduced effectiveness over 50. Each point over this threshold will only give half value for the purpose of calculating hit chance:
units.zh: 防御超过 50 后，超出部分在命中率计算中只按一半计入：

units.source: That, however, does not mean that it is not worth increasing defense past 50. On the contrary, the closer it brings the enemies to 5% hit chance, the greater returns are for each point spent. For example, if an enemy has melee attack 80 (hit chance 80 if melee defense is 0), then it takes 40 points (from 0 to 40) to halve that probability and double the survivability of the defender. Then it takes only 30 more points to double it again (defense 40=>70, hit chance 40=>20), then 20 points (defense 70=>90, hit chance 20=>10) and, finally, only 10 points (defense 90=>100, hit chance 10=>5). Despite the fact that defense is halved over 50, increasing it past that point is nonetheless much more effective than below that threshold.
units.zh: 这并不意味着防御超过 50 后就不值得继续提高。恰恰相反，越接近把敌人的命中率压到 5%，每点防御的生存收益就越高。例如，敌人的近战命中为 80，面对近战防御 0 的目标时，命中率就是 80。先投入 40 点防御，从 0 升至 40，才能使命中率减半、生存能力翻倍；之后只需再加 30 点便能再次翻倍（防御 40→70，命中率 40→20），接着只需 20 点（防御 70→90，命中率 20→10），最后仅需 10 点（防御 90→100，命中率 10→5）。因此，尽管超过 50 的防御在计算中减半，继续投入的生存收益仍可能远高于较低防御时。

units.source: Surrounding occurs when two or more enemies are adjacent to an ally. Each enemy above the first reduces the defense of the surrounded unit making it easier for everyone to hit it.
units.zh: 当一名友军与至少两名敌人相邻时，就会遭到包围。除第一个敌人外，每多一个相邻敌人，受围单位的防御就会进一步降低，让所有攻击者都更容易击中它。

units.source: If the attacker is on a tile that's more elevated than his target's a +10% bonus to hit chance is granted. If the attacker is on a tile that is below his target's a −10% penalty to hit chance per level difference is applied.
units.zh: 攻击者高于目标时，命中率获得 +10% 加成；低于目标时，每相差一个高度层级，命中率受到 −10% 惩罚。

units.source: Some skills ignore the defense bonus granted by shields. Shieldwall is unaffected.
units.zh: 某些技能无视盾牌本身提供的防御加成，但不会无视盾墙的加成。

units.source: The line of fire for ranged attacks can be obstructed by obstacles. Some hinder sight completely making it impossible to select the target they hide. Others just make it more difficult to reach a blocked target. In that case a red arrow blocked by a shield is displayed over the obstacle.
units.zh: 远程攻击的射线可能被障碍物阻挡。有些障碍物会彻底遮蔽视线，令其后的目标无法选中；另一些只会让目标更难命中，此时障碍物上方会显示一支被盾牌挡住的红色箭头。

units.source: The base hit chance penalty to reach a blocked target is 75%. The Bullseye Perk reduces it to 50% (* 0.66). If this fails the shot goes astray. One among the intended target obstacles is randomly chosen and targeted instead.
units.zh: 攻击被遮挡的目标时，基础上有 75% 的概率被障碍物拦截。“鹰眼”特长将其降低到 50%（乘以 0.66）。未能穿过遮挡时，射击会偏离，并从遮挡预定目标的障碍物中随机选取一个作为新目标。

units.source: If the shot goes astray a −15% penalty to hit chance is applied. Attacks made over allies at a range of 2 tiles are not blocked.
units.zh: 射击偏离时，命中率受到 −15% 惩罚。越过友军攻击距离为 2 格的目标时，不会被友军挡住。

units.source: The hit chance for some skills is modified with distance (in tiles). At distance = 1 (adjacent), hit chance is unmodified.
units.zh: 某些技能的命中率随距离变化，距离以格计。距离 = 1，也就是相邻时，不产生距离修正。

units.source: Hit chance for regular attacks cannot be lower than 5% and cannot go higher than 95%.
units.zh: 普通攻击的命中率最低为 5%，最高为 95%。

units.source: The hit roll is a random number between 1 and 100. If it is lower than the hit chance the attack hits.
units.zh: 命中掷骰会生成 1 到 100 之间的随机数；若结果低于命中率，攻击便会命中。

units.source: If beginner combat difficulty has been selected all hit rolls are modified in favor of the player making it easier for the player to hit enemies and harder for enemies to hit the player.
units.zh: 选择初学者战斗难度时，命中掷骰会向玩家有利的方向调整，使玩家更容易击中敌人，敌人更难击中玩家。

units.source: If the target is hit and has the Lucky Trait the hit roll is rolled again (once).
units.zh: 若被命中的目标拥有“幸运”特性，则会重新进行一次命中掷骰。

units.source: Projectiles that miss a target (intended or not) at a distance > 2 tiles can scatter and hit adjacent targets. For attackers other than the player the chance is 25% but no ally must be adjacent to the target. For those attackers as well as player controlled units either one of these additional conditions must be met:
units.zh: 当射击距离 > 2 格且未命中目标时，无论该目标是原定目标还是偏离后的目标，弹射物都可能散射并命中其相邻目标。非玩家控制的攻击者有 25% 的机会触发，但目标身旁不能有攻击者的友军。无论攻击者是否由玩家控制，还须满足下列附加条件之一：

units.source: So even if the target has a shield there's a chance for the projectile to scatter. The shield and Shiedwall bonus take into account Shield Expert.
units.zh: 因此，即使目标持盾，弹射物仍有可能散射。盾牌与盾墙的加成都会计入盾牌精通的影响。

units.source: A scattered shot hits as normal but it cannot go astray or scatter again.
units.zh: 散射后的射击按普通规则判定命中，但不会再次偏离或散射。

units.source: If a target is hit a roll is made to determine what body part is hit. If the head is hit the hit is a critical hit and will do additional {#1}damage{/#1}.
units.zh: 攻击命中后，还会掷骰决定击中的部位。命中头部视为暴击，造成额外{#1}伤害{/#1}。

units.source: Defense helps avoid hits. Melee Defense protects against melee attacks while Ranged Defense protects against ranged attacks. Defense is affected by many variables. Modifiers specific to a type are listed under 'Melee' or 'Ranged' sections. Enemies, backgrounds and levels will not be studied here. See the relevant articles.
units.zh: 防御用于避开攻击：近战防御应对近战攻击，远程防御应对远程攻击。影响防御的因素很多，仅作用于某一类防御的修正列在“近战”或“远程”章节。这里不讨论敌人、背景和等级带来的差异，请参阅对应页面。

units.source: Skill increases chance to hit. Melee skill targets melee defense while ranged skill targets ranged defense. Skill is affected by many variables. Modifiers specific to a type are listed under 'Melee' or 'Ranged' sections. Enemies, backgrounds and levels will not be studied here. See the relevant articles.
units.zh: 命中属性决定击中目标的机会：近战命中与近战防御相对，远程命中与远程防御相对。影响命中的因素很多，仅作用于某一类命中的修正列在“近战”或“远程”章节。这里不讨论敌人、背景和等级带来的差异，请参阅对应页面。

units.source: Champions are stronger versions of enemies that always have a named item. They have a skull mark on their tokens, and generate with unique names. Only certain enemies can become champions.
units.zh: 精英勇士是敌人的强化变体，必定携带名贵装备。他们的底座上有骷髅标记，并拥有独特的名字。只有特定敌人能成为精英勇士。

units.source: Each type of enemy has its own base chance to spawn a champion instead of a regular enemy. However, there are conditions that can affect this chance. These modifiers are additive.
units.zh: 每种敌人都有各自的基础概率，以精英变体替代普通个体生成。某些条件会改变这一概率，各项修正相加计算。

units.source: Most champions have extra {#1}perks{/#1} in comparison to their regular counterparts, and their {#2}attributes{/#2} are also increased.
units.zh: 多数精英勇士比普通同类拥有更多{#1}特长{/#1}，{#2}属性{/#2}也更高。

units.source: Actually, it is the special Champion perk that is responsible for increasing stats. Modifiers are conditional, based on the enemy base defense values. 20 points in either melee or ranged defense, or 15 in both, cause the set with extra defense to apply, otherwise it will be the one with extra HP.
units.zh: 属性提升实际由特殊的“精英勇士”特长提供，所用加成组取决于敌人的基础防御：近战或远程防御有一项达到 20，或两项均达到 15，就使用偏重防御的加成；否则使用偏重生命值的加成。

units.source: Modifiers are multiplicative. A regular {#1}Swordmaster{/#1} has 80 base melee defense and a {#2}champion{/#2} has 80*1.5625 = 125. If an enemy has a damage modifier, it is multiplied as well. Final values are rounded down.
units.zh: 这些修正以乘法计算。例如，普通{#1}剑术大师{/#1}的基础近战防御为 80，{#2}精英变体{/#2}则为 80*1.5625 = 125。敌人原有的伤害修正也会参与乘算，最终数值向下取整。

units.source: It's important that these modifiers are applied {#1}{#2}after{/#2}{/#1} {#3}shields{/#3}, {#4}Dodge{/#4}, {#5}Fast Adaptation{/#5}, extra {#6}weapon{/#6} accuracy and such. They are multiplied as well! So if you attack a {#7}champion Knight{/#7} with 20 base melee defense and a {#8}Heater Shield{/#8} that gives 25 with {#9}Shield Expert{/#9}, don't expect it to be 20*1.5625+25 = 56. It is (20+25)*1.5625 = 70, so your accuracy will be reduced by 60 (not 70, because all defense above 50 has half effect). {#10}Dodge{/#10} benefits from both initiative and defense increase.
units.zh: 这些倍率在{#3}盾牌{/#3}、{#4}闪避{/#4}、{#5}快速适应{/#5}、{#6}武器{/#6}额外命中等加成{#1}{#2}之后{/#2}{/#1}生效，因此上述加成也会一起放大！例如，一名{#7}精英骑士{/#7}拥有 20 基础近战防御，携带在{#9}盾牌精通{/#9}加持下提供 25 防御的{#8}熨斗形盾{/#8}。其防御不是 20*1.5625+25 = 56，而是 (20+25)*1.5625 = 70。它会使你的命中率降低 60，而非 70，因为超过 50 的防御只按一半生效。{#10}闪避{/#10}则会同时受益于先攻提升和防御提升。

units.source: {#1}Named{/#1} {#2}weapons{/#2}, {#3}armors{/#3} and {#4}helmets{/#4} always drop, even with zero durability, but {#5}named shields{/#5} are destroyed if they break!
units.zh: {#1}名贵{/#1}{#2}武器{/#2}、{#3}护甲{/#3}和{#4}头盔{/#4}必定掉落，耐久归零也不例外；但{#5}名贵盾牌{/#5}一旦被击碎，就会永久损毁！

units.source: Values in parentheses represent stats modified by Champion perk, or possible named armor durabitity.
units.zh: 括号内的数值表示受“精英勇士”特长加成后的属性，或可能出现的名贵护甲耐久。

units.source: Most champions have resolve so high that {#1}Fearsome{/#1} becomes useless. It also causes non-{#2}undead{/#2} champions to become {#3}confident{/#3} if they see their enemy die. Confident morale applies an additional multiplier to their already high stats.
units.zh: 多数精英勇士的意志极高，{#1}威慑{/#1}几乎难以奏效。非{#2}亡灵{/#2}精英在目睹敌人死亡时，也很容易变得{#3}斗志昂扬{/#3}，让本已很高的属性再乘上一层士气加成。

units.source: Their high accuracy allows them to reliably hit evasive characters.
units.zh: 他们命中很高，即使面对擅长闪避的角色，也能稳定击中。

units.source: With increased damage, {#1}named weapons{/#1} and {#2}Crippling Strikes{/#2} they can inflict {#3}injuries{/#3} very early no matter what. {#4}Iron Will Potion{/#4} gives immunity to them.
units.zh: 凭借伤害加成、{#1}名贵武器{/#1}和{#2}致残打击{/#2}，他们往往很快就能打出{#3}伤势{/#3}。{#4}钢铁意志药剂{/#4}可以使角色免受伤势效果影响。

units.source: Have some means of escape: {#1}Rotation{/#1}, {#2}Footwork{/#2} or a {#3}Smoke Pot{/#3}.
{#1}Nets{/#1} and {#2}ranged weapons{/#2}, preferably {#3}throwing{/#3}, are required to fight them. Poisons work well.
units.zh: 对付他们需要{#1}捕网{/#1}和{#2}远程武器{/#2}，其中尤以{#3}投掷武器{/#3}为佳。毒药也很有效。

units.source: These deal very high damage and sometimes are capable of killing a brother in one hit of a named two-handed weapon.
units.zh: 这类精英伤害极高，手持名贵双手武器时，有时一击就能杀死一名弟兄。

units.source: {#1}Stunlock{/#1} is effective against them. Some champions require nets or {#2}disarm{/#2}.
units.zh: 持续施加{#1}眩晕{/#1}很有效。某些精英还需要用捕网或{#2}缴械{/#2}控制。

units.source: These rely on a shield to achieve high defense values, and are usually heavily armored.
units.zh: 这类精英依靠盾牌获得极高防御，通常还穿着重甲。

units.source: {#1}Two-Handed Flail{/#1} has both armor penetration and accuracy against {#2}shields{/#2}, and you may want to use nets for extra hit chance. Alternatively, you can just break the shield, but you won't loot a named shield this way.
units.zh: {#1}双手连枷{/#1}既能穿透护甲，又能在对抗{#2}盾牌{/#2}时保持命中优势；还可用捕网进一步提高命中率。另一种办法是直接砸碎盾牌，但这样便无法缴获名贵盾牌。

units.source: These can deal damage from range and pick targets.
units.zh: 这类精英可以从远处输出伤害，并挑选目标。

units.source: Engage them in melee as soon as you can. Prefer nighttime.
units.zh: 尽快贴近，迫使他们近战；尽量在夜间交战。

units.source: Everyone who lacks threat and defense falls into this category.
units.zh: 威胁较低、防御也不突出的精英都归入这一类。

units.source: Champions are particularly skilled and experienced individuals of any non-beast faction. They’re guaranteed to carry one {#1}Named Item{/#1} and have significantly increased stats over their brethren. You’ll be able to easily recognize them by their special base and unique name. They are, in a way, minibosses. They challenge you to fight hard to claim what is theirs, and they shake things up, but prevailing against them will always reward you with the {#2}Named Item{/#2} they carry – be it weapon, shield, armor or helmet.
units.zh: 精英勇士是各非野兽势力中技艺与经验格外出众的个体。他们必定携带一件{#1}名贵装备{/#1}，属性明显强于同类，也可通过特殊底座和独特名字轻易辨认。从某种意义上说，他们就是小型首领：要夺取他们的宝物，必须经历一场苦战。他们为战局增添变数，战胜后则能获得所携带的{#2}名贵装备{/#2}，可能是武器、盾牌、护甲或头盔。

units.source: So where do you meet champions? The most reliable way is to complete {#1}Contracts{/#1} with a difficulty rating of {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} three skulls. Those have always been a high risk proposition for any mercenary company, but they now come with more of a reward for taking that chance: the possibility of getting named gear by facing enemy champions. Another way is to simply play into the late game. The further along your campaign, the more likely that you’ll find champions roaming the world outside of {#5}Contracts{/#5} or defending a location.
units.zh: 到哪里找精英勇士？最可靠的办法，是完成难度为{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}三颗骷髅的{#1}委托{/#1}。这类委托一向风险很高，如今也提供了额外回报：有机会遭遇精英敌人，夺取名贵装备。另一种办法是把战役推进到后期。战役进行得越久，越可能在{#5}委托{/#5}之外，遇见游荡于世界或守卫据点的精英勇士。

units.source: While champions may prove challenging to defeat, they are significantly easier to beat than some of the battles around {#1}Legendary Locations{/#1}. This way, they can also fill the gap in challenge between defeating your first late game crisis and starting to take on {#2}Legendary Locations{/#2}, like the {#3}Black Monolith{/#3}, with your company.{#4}{#5}{#6}[{/#6}1{#7}]{/#7}{/#5}{/#4}
units.zh: 精英勇士虽然难对付，但仍比某些{#1}传奇地点{/#1}的战斗容易得多。因此，他们也填补了从第一次渡过后期危机，到挑战{#3}黑色巨石{/#3}等{#2}传奇地点{/#2}之间的难度空档。{#4}{#5}{#6}[{/#6}1{#7}]{/#7}{/#5}{/#4}
